zhumagazy-haziret-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum is located in Karaoba, Toganas rural district, Syrym district, West Kazakhstan region. As a young man, Zhumagazy was a religious figure who studied and served in the mosque of Hazrat Sultan Khoja Ahmed Yassawi in Turkestan for several years.

One of the legends about the virtues and mysteries of Hazrat Zhumagazy: “After returning from Turkestan, Hazrat Zhumagazy met with the elders of the Kazakh tribes living in the area between the present-day Syrym and Terekty districts. But the rabbis do not listen to Zhumagazi's request. At that moment, Zhumagazy, who was turning away, saw a fire burning behind him. One of the elders noticed this and said, "Oh, people, this man was not a free man. We have to fulfill his request and give him land!" According to another legend, which describes his special qualities, it is said: Then the scaly ice cart lifted its feathers, and the puppy that followed the cart crawled and blessed the water.It is believed that Zhumagazy was the land of modern Tamasai and Ubeniyaz pastures. Although winter pastures are in Karaoba, in summer they are located in the south-west, in Kauz and Tamasai.

These days, his hometown, Karaoba, is busy. Many people come from far and wide to visit the bural place of the saint and spend the night there.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. – 273-274-pp.

kuishi-mamen-muratuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Kuishi Mamen Muratuli
kuishi-mamen-muratuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Kuishi Mamen Muratuli is located in Pyatimar aul of Zhanakala district of West Kazakhstan region.
kuishi-mamen-muratuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Kuishi Mamen Muratuli is located in Pyatimar aul of Zhanakala district of West Kazakhstan region. Mamen Muratovich, one of the most talented kuishi-composers born in the sacred Naryn, lived in Kamyssamar (1868-1931) of Zhanakala district of the West Kazakhstan region.
kuishi-mamen-muratuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Kuishi Mamen Muratuli is located in Pyatimar aul of Zhanakala district of West Kazakhstan region. Mamen Muratovich, one of the most talented kuishi-composers born in the sacred Naryn, lived in Kamyssamar (1868-1931) of Zhanakala district of the West Kazakhstan region.Mamen is one of the suppliers of a large musical fund in the Golden Horde. Continuing the immortal art of Kurmangazy, which he foresaw, he remained in the history of the region not only with his masterful performance, but also with his kui. He learned from Kurmangazy and propagated his kuis (“Aday”,“Baizhuma”,“Toremurat”, “Teriskakpay”, etc.). Mamen, who has a deep knowledge of his teacher's performance style, has composed kuis “Ak Sholpan”, “Kaigyly kara”, “Karazhan khanym”, “Kerbez akzhelen” and others. There are kuis “1916” and “1917”, which symbolize the turbulent period in the Kazakh steppes in the early XX century. Mamen kiuis are rich in packages that inspire with deep emotion, dynamic and playful rhythm of music. Mamen's mastery of kuishi and performance was highly appreciated by art researchers. Dombra players R. Omarov, A. Iskaliev, B. Karabalina were recognized as his students.

References: 1. Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. – 201-p.; 2.The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume-2. –Astana: 2018. –288-p.

qozhantai-qazhy-meshiti.name: Kozhantai Hajji Mosque
qozhantai-qazhy-meshiti.fact: The mosque is a sacred place located in Zhalpaktal village of Kaztalov district of West Kazakhstan region.
qozhantai-qazhy-meshiti.lead: The mosque is a sacred place located in Zhalpaktal village of Kaztalov district of West Kazakhstan region. The mosque was built in 1885 by Kazan Tatar Kozhantai Haji.
qozhantai-qazhy-meshiti.bodyHtml:
The mosque is a sacred place located in Zhalpaktal village of Kaztalov district of West Kazakhstan region. The mosque was built in 1885 by Kazan Tatar Kozhantai Haji. The mosque was renovated in 1988 and is a two-storey architectural monument with two minarets.

The mosque is built of red brick. The burnt bricks were transported by 30 camels from Ershov district of Saratov region of Russia. The brick factory made the bricks by kneading horse milk and hair on fresh clay soil and roasting them. The mosque was built according to a Tatar project without a dome. On the ground floor there was a room for children to study, lectures, and a room for ablution. The mosque can accommodate 400 people at a time. It is said that Gumar Karash taught here. There is evidence that the basement, ie the basement, was heated by burning firewood. Reeds were brought from Akkol (Sakryl) Lake, 10 km from Zhalpaktal village. The interior was finished with high-quality cement and lime, as well as other high-quality additives. The exterior of the mosque is unadorned, in the form of its original natural stones. The roof is made of wooden beams and the floors are made of thick oak.

Until 1936, the doors of the mosque were open. Due to the establishment of the Soviet government, the two towers were destroyed and the mullahs were persecuted and closed. From 1937 to 1983 the mosque was the Zhalpaktal district House of Culture. During the Second World War (1941-1945) the mosque was used as a warehouse for grain and food. It was vacant in 1983-1987. Only in 1988 it was overhauled and until 1995 it worked as Zhalpaktal district museum of local lore.

In 1995, by the decision of the Zhalpaktal district administration № 95, the district was reorganized into a Muslim mosque.

References: 1. Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. – 178-p.; 2.The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume-2. –Astana: 2018. –280-p.

qyz-aulie-bulagy.name: Kyz Aulie Spring
qyz-aulie-bulagy.fact: Kyz Aulie spring is located in the Karaagash forest near the village of Aksuat, Shyngyrlau district, West Kazakhstan…
qyz-aulie-bulagy.lead: Kyz Aulie spring is located in the Karaagash forest near the village of Aksuat, Shyngyrlau district, West Kazakhstan region. The water of the spring originates from the calcareous layer of the Syrt aldy belt, on the Ural plateau.
qyz-aulie-bulagy.bodyHtml:
Kyz Aulie spring is located in the Karaagash forest near the village of Aksuat, Shyngyrlau district, West Kazakhstan region. The water of the spring originates from the calcareous layer of the Syrt aldy belt, on the Ural plateau.The girl said about the sacred spring: “Once upon a time, the daughter of a man named Nurgali named Salika discovered the spring at the age of 11. He told his mother, “I am 17 years old and my brother is 15 years old. I discovered the source of this spring. If I am one during the day, I will be ten at night. " According to the legend, he and his brother died at the same age. That is why the transparent spring is called “Kyz Aulie”. He wishes the well-being of the tall and short trees growing around him, trust in the country, the well-being of children, the purity of the feelings of youth. There is a legend that a holy girl looks after the spring, waits and cleans it. Even in the village of Aksuat, when a missing child was searched as a village and found in two days, the child was called a saint who drank water from a spring and did not feed dogs and birds.Even today, visitors are told: “If you put soap and laundry soap together, the soap will disappear. It is often said that a holy girl will marry him. On hot summer days, the spring is clear, and in winter it never freezes at 40 degrees below zero. Large amounts of silver were found in the water. Water has a good effect on stomach ailments, musculoskeletal system, restores blood pressure.

References: 1. Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. – 171-p.; 2.The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume-2. –Astana: 2018. –281-p.

uki-bi-kesenesi.name: Uki Bi Mausoleum
uki-bi-kesenesi.fact: Uki Bi is a prominent figure in the socio-political life of the Younger Zhuz, an active participant in the affairs of…
uki-bi-kesenesi.lead: Uki Bi is a prominent figure in the socio-political life of the Younger Zhuz, an active participant in the affairs of the country, whose name is marked in the archives of that time.
uki-bi-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
Uki Bi is a prominent figure in the socio-political life of the Younger Zhuz, an active participant in the affairs of the country, whose name is marked in the archives of that time. His activity dates back to the time of the famous Syrym batyr and developed in connection with the complex historical events of the reign of Aishuak, Zhantore, Shergazy, Bokei khans, Karatay, Orman, Aryngazy sultans. In other words, the tension in the Junior Zhuz at that time was reflected in the events and sought to restore relations within the country. Owl dance serves the people in the political context of the time.It is said that no one stopped at the words of Uki bi, who was famous in his time as the Junior Zhuz. Local historian Zh. Abylpeisov: “He was a big man holding two people on his shoulder.The Cossack-Russians, who did not allow the Kazakh name to enter the Zhayk, were afraid of the Uki Bi and could not abuse the country around them”. According to folklore, after the death of Syrym in Khiva in 1802, Uki Bi was one of the famous figures of the Junior Zhuz who went to inquire about the value of the hero. The embassy headed by Eskara Batyr, the son of the famous Daukara Batyr under the motto of the Baibakty clan, included 7-8 people from Alteke: Kozhamsugir Uki bi, Alasha Baramyk Oshyrty bi, Issyk Karatau bi, Berish Bodene, Baibakty Kushpen Tailak batyr. Each of them was a prominent citizen of the Junior Zhuz at that time, who could answer to the fate of one tribe.Uki Bi mausoleum is located in Kyzylzhar aul of Bazartobe district of Akzhayik district.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. – 184-p.

shalqar-koli.name: Shalkar Lake
shalqar-koli.fact: Lake Shalkar is one of the natural monuments of the Ural region.
shalqar-koli.lead: Lake Shalkar is one of the natural monuments of the Ural region. It is located in Terekty district of West Kazakhstan region. Lake Shalkar is a lake of special ecological, scientific, cultural, recreational and aesthetic value.
shalqar-koli.bodyHtml:
Lake Shalkar is one of the natural monuments of the Ural region. It is located in Terekty district of West Kazakhstan region. Lake Shalkar is a lake of special ecological, scientific, cultural, recreational and aesthetic value. It belongs to the basin of the Ural River. The Sholakankaty and Esenankaty rivers flow into the lake, and when the water level rises to 15.5 m, the river leaves the lake. Swans, geese, ducks, flamingos, gulls, etc. live in the lake. birds are found.

From ancient times, Lake Shalkar attracted attention, its shores were inhabited by Oguzs and Pechenegs, and later by Kipchak and Turkic tribes - the ancestors of the Kazakh people. This is evidenced by the works of the Arab merchant, scientist Ahmed ibn Fadlan, who visited the Volga Bulgaria in 921-922. Describing his travels from Khorezm to Bulgaria, Ahmed ibn Fadlan paid much attention to the paleography of the Eurasian core in the Middle Ages. In his stories, the Oguz and Pecheneg tribes inhabit the area around Lake Shalkar, and Shamar, Ankaty, and Vabna (Junior Ankaty) flow into the lake. "These are big rivers," he said.

Locals also call Shalkar “Little Sea”. This natural body of water is considered to be very old, and its origin is still controversial. However, one version is satisfactory. The lake is a suffix of the former Khvalin Sea, which was drawn from the Caspian Sea a thousand years ago, and therefore prehistorically was the aforementioned sea on the site of the entire present-day Caspian basin.

The water of Shalkar Lake belongs to the type of salt chloride-sodium mineral water. Water contains hydrochloric acid, calcium bicarbonate, magnesium and other essential minerals. Lake Shalkar has always been an attractive place, so since the X century there have been settlements and urban settlements. Merchants and missionaries were here at different times.

References: 1. Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. – 166-p.; 2.The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume-2. –Astana: 2018. –318-p.

baizaq-datqa-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Baizak Mambetuli
baizaq-datqa-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Baizak Mambetuli is located on a hill on the border of Dikhan and Sarykemer rural districts of Baizak…
baizaq-datqa-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Baizak Mambetuli is located on a hill on the border of Dikhan and Sarykemer rural districts of Baizak district of Zhambyl region.Baizak Datka Mambetuli (1789-1864) was a hero who organized the national liberation struggle against the Kokand Khanate and the Russian Empire.
baizaq-datqa-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Baizak Mambetuli is located on a hill on the border of Dikhan and Sarykemer rural districts of Baizak district of Zhambyl region.Baizak Datka Mambetuli (1789-1864) was a hero who organized the national liberation struggle against the Kokand Khanate and the Russian Empire. From an early age Baizak mastered horsemanship, bird-watching and sniping. Growing up, he was a village elder, a centurion, a captain. He organized the country for business, settlement, digging ditches and farming.

Baizak Mambetuli grew up as an independent man, the head of the aul, during the independence of his native land, which did not belong to either the Kokand Khanate or Russia. After the conquest of the southern region by the Kokand Khanate, he and his brother Baiterek took part in the uprising led by Sultan Rustem Asfendiyaruli (1821). Baizak Mambetuli, as an authoritative person, was appointed as a datka to his relatives. Datka disobeyed the Kokand colonizers and sought to pursue an independent policy, protecting the interests of the Kazakhs. He became known as a reliable companion of Kenesary Kasymuly in the struggle against the colonizers.

References: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –358-360-pp.

qaraqozha-meshiti.name: Karakozha Mosque
qaraqozha-meshiti.fact: Karakozha Mosque is one of the most beautiful architectural monuments in the Talas region. It was built in 1909.
qaraqozha-meshiti.lead: Karakozha Mosque is one of the most beautiful architectural monuments in the Talas region. It was built in 1909. It is located on a flat plain near the aul of Seilbek, Oyik aul, Talas district, Zhambyl region.
qaraqozha-meshiti.bodyHtml:
Karakozha Mosque is one of the most beautiful architectural monuments in the Talas region. It was built in 1909. It is located on a flat plain near the aul of Seilbek, Oyik aul, Talas district, Zhambyl region.In his time, the construction of the Karakozha mosque was influenced by Zhupan ana. Zhupan is the daughter-in-law of a noble family, blessed, and despite the fact that she is a young widow from her husband, she perseveres and leads the construction of this historic facility. First, she went to Tashkent, where she brought carpenters and built this mosque. After the construction of the mosque was completed, fourteen-year-old Karakozha was appointed imam. During the construction of the mosque, the people of the area were involved in good deeds.The mosque is one of the most frequented holy places, forming a complex adjacent to the Chechen Memorial.Karakozha mosque is decorated in the architectural style of the Shu-Talas region of the XIX century. The structure is rectangular, made of baked pieces. The arched quince on the eastern side is covered with nine domes of the same size. Only the dome of the hall where the mihrab is located is quite high. This highlights the importance of religious construction in a large-scale project. The low facade is made of ceramic bricks and plastered.

It is written in the central mihrab that the work was done in 1327 according to hegira calender.

References: 1. Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –222 p;

2.The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume 3 –Astana, 2019. –56- p.

merki-turki-guryptyq-kesheni.name: Merke-Zhaisan Turkish Customs Complex
merki-turki-guryptyq-kesheni.fact: Zhambyl region is located 37 km from Merke district.
merki-turki-guryptyq-kesheni.lead: Zhambyl region is located 37 km from Merke district. Chronological period: VII-VIII centuries.Merke Turkic Horde and Jaisan Temple are cultural and ritual complexes of medieval Turks.
merki-turki-guryptyq-kesheni.bodyHtml:
Zhambyl region is located 37 km from Merke district. Chronological period: VII-VIII centuries.Merke Turkic Horde and Jaisan Temple are cultural and ritual complexes of medieval Turks. The group of complex monuments in this area - burial places - burial mounds, ceremonial fences around the mounds, stone sculptures, balbal stones, rock paintings and tribal symbols and carvings found on the rocks. The main part of the monuments is based on one rule, depending on their location. That is, while the burial structures are located in the western part of the complex, the ceremonial structures are concentrated in the eastern part of the complex. Only in rare cases the fences are located in the middle of the mounds or in the western part of the cult complexes. The works of art of the Turks, which are an integral part of the Jaisan temple, are concentrated in the area southwest of the memorial. Such works of art include tribal symbols, petroglyphs, etc., found on stone sculptures and stelae, as well as on rocks. applies.The temple of Merke has long been a unique ritual complex of the Western Turks, located in the Kazakh steppes, and the temple of Jaisan was built a hundred years after the establishment of the Western Turkic khaganate, in the VIII century, when the eastern Turks came to the lands of the western Turkic tribes.

References: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –130-133 pp.

agybai-qonyrbaiuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Agybay Konyrbayuli
agybai-qonyrbaiuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Agybay Batyr is located in the valley of the river Bosaga, near the mountain Tayatkan-Shunak…
agybai-qonyrbaiuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Agybay Batyr is located in the valley of the river Bosaga, near the mountain Tayatkan-Shunak, northeast of Betpakdala. XIX century preserved architectural monument.
agybai-qonyrbaiuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Agybay Batyr is located in the valley of the river Bosaga, near the mountain Tayatkan-Shunak, northeast of Betpakdala. XIX century preserved architectural monument. Agybay Batyr Konyrbayuli (1802–1885) was one of the commanders of the Kenesary Kasymuly uprising. He was called "Akzholtai Batyr" since he was always lucky.

Shuburtpaly Agybay batyr herd together with Bukarbay batyr fought against the rulers of Khiva and Kokand. In 1826-1849, the army led by Agybay Batyr, he fought face to face with Russian troops and suffered several devastating blows. He attacked the strongholds of the Russian Empire in Kazakhstan - Karkaraly, Aktau, Akmola, Ekaterin, defeated the tsarist forces in the battles on the rivers Irgiz, Tobol, Kyzylzhar, Kokshetau. Later, until 1849, he independently attacked the fortresses of the Russian government.The life of the main hero of Kenesary Agybay was based on the works of Kazakh historians and writers. At the end of the XIX century the story “Agybay Batyr” was published. He is the main character of the song “Nauryzbai-Kanshaiym” by A. Nysanbai Zhyrau, the novel “Kahar” by I. Esenberlin. Agybay Batyr's sagan is in the second place in the far north-west corner of the room. It is square, one-room, domed, with a tower. There are 12 corpses in the mausoleum.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –368-369-pp.

aiaqqamyr-kesenesi.name: The Mausoleum of Ayakkamyr
aiaqqamyr-kesenesi.fact: Ayakkamyr mausoleum is one of the most important monuments of Central Kazakhstan in the late IX-XII centuries.
aiaqqamyr-kesenesi.lead: Ayakkamyr mausoleum is one of the most important monuments of Central Kazakhstan in the late IX-XII centuries. It is located 9 km north-west of Zhezdy village of Ulytau district of Karaganda region.
aiaqqamyr-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
Ayakkamyr mausoleum is one of the most important monuments of Central Kazakhstan in the late IX-XII centuries. It is located 9 km north-west of Zhezdy village of Ulytau district of Karaganda region. The architectural structure and decoration are typical of the buildings of the Oguz-Kipchak epoch. To the west, 300 m away, there is the town of Ayakkamyr.

The mausoleum is a portal-centered complex. Its front side is framed like the letter P and decorated in the form of a monument. The entrance cavity is covered with a straight arch. It was built of burnt bricks and covered with half-carved boards. The rectangular construction plan consists of three dimensions: the cube of the building, the portal and the dome.Academician A.H. Margulan speculates that the tomb of Ayakkamyr was built for Kutlyk Temir, a descendant of Genghis Khan. The mausoleum of Ayakkamyr is mentioned in the researches of Sh. Valikhanov and G. Gerasimov. There are not many legends about the mausoleum among the locals. The researcher G. Gerasimov says in his work: “... There are no legends among the locals about how and when this mausoleum appeared. The ruins of the mausoleum show that it is the oldest mausoleum in the region. This mausoleum is also known as Temirkutlyk mausoleum. However, a similar name is given to the second, less attractive mausoleum, located 15-16 km from the dome. “It is difficult to say exactly which of them has the right name 'Temirkutlyk', since we do not have historical data on this issue”, he said.The mausoleum was first studied in 1946 by the Central Kazakhstan Archaeological Expedition of the Academy of Sciences of the Kazakh SSR (A.H. Margulan).

References: 1. Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –258 p; 2. The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume 3 –Astana, 2019. –115-p.

baigozy-naimantaiuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Baigozy Naimantaiuly
baigozy-naimantaiuly-kesenesi.fact: Koktynkol village, 50 km north-west of Akadyr village, Shet district, Karaganda region, near Zhylandy subdivision.
baigozy-naimantaiuly-kesenesi.lead: Koktynkol village, 50 km north-west of Akadyr village, Shet district, Karaganda region, near Zhylandy subdivision. Baigozy Naimantaiuli (1705-1803) was one of the flag-bearing heroes of Abylai Khan, who performed great feats in the war against the Dzungar invasion in defense of the country and freedom of the Kazakh people.
baigozy-naimantaiuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
Koktynkol village, 50 km north-west of Akadyr village, Shet district, Karaganda region, near Zhylandy subdivision. Baigozy Naimantaiuli (1705-1803) was one of the flag-bearing heroes of Abylai Khan, who performed great feats in the war against the Dzungar invasion in defense of the country and freedom of the Kazakh people. The mother of Baigozy batyr is Sholpan, the sister of Tarkhan Eset batyr, who ruled the Zhetyru of the Junior Zhuz. His father Naimantai batyr Sutemgenuly was one of the main heroes of Tauke khan. In a battle with the Dzungars, Baigozy shot the Kalmyk leader with a bow, repulsed the enemy, saved the Kazakh army led by Abylai Khan and Shakshak Zhanibek from defeat and led to an unexpected victory. Baigozy's name became known from then on.The stories of Baigozy Batyr, who was in the middle of the battles between the Kazakh and Kalmyk troops and showed great feats, can be found in the works of Chokan Valikhanov, Mashkhur-Zhusup Kopeyev, in the poems of such poets as Zhanak and Shuzhe. In his essay on the heroes of the XVIII century, Chokan Valikhanov interestingly tells about the heroic deeds of Baigozy batyr, along with such famous heroes as Zhanibek, Bayan, Zhanatay.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –334-335-pp.

bolgan-ana-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Bolgan Ana
bolgan-ana-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum is one of the most outstanding monuments of the Golden Horde period (XIV-XV) in Central Kazakhstan, the…
bolgan-ana-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum is one of the most outstanding monuments of the Golden Horde period (XIV-XV) in Central Kazakhstan, the best work of architecture. It is located 3 km above the confluence of the rivers Karakengir and Sarysu in Ulytau district of Karaganda region.
bolgan-ana-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum is one of the most outstanding monuments of the Golden Horde period (XIV-XV) in Central Kazakhstan, the best work of architecture. It is located 3 km above the confluence of the rivers Karakengir and Sarysu in Ulytau district of Karaganda region.There is a lot of information about who Bolgan ana was in real life. One of them says that Bolgan ana was the daughter-in-law of Alasha khan, and according to another legend, she was the queen who ruled here in Central Kazakhstan until the arrival of the Dzungars in the early XV century.

Another legend says that Bolgan ana was the granddaughter of the famous Genghis Khan, who conquered half the world. Evidence of this can be found in the writings of scholars who wrote in Arabic, Persian and Turkic languages about eight centuries ago that in 1211 the khan of the Kangli state of Bolgan was extended to Syganak-tegin (some historical works call him Suknak). In the writings of Rashid-ad-Din, in the works of academician V.V. Bartold, it is written that Bolgan ana (Bolgan begi) was the daughter of Jochi khan.Built in a prominent place, the Bolgan Ana dome seems to have been very beautiful in the first versions. The structure of the mausoleum is one-room, built of burnt bricks. The beam on the facade is hollow around the entrance to the portal and is made as a wall pattern. The lower square of the room is trumpeted through the corners at the entrance to the dome. Trump's armpits are decorated with a double brick with a sloping corner. The main facade-portal is decorated with two P-shaped skirts, one of which was a geometric ornament. Only one or two decorative bricks have survived to this day.

References: 1. Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –256 p; 2. The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume 3 –Astana, 2019. –130 p.

dulygaly-meshiti.name: Mosque of Dulygaly
dulygaly-meshiti.fact: Dulygaly mosque is located in Ulytau district of Karaganda region, on the river Ashyly, 135 km from the village of…
dulygaly-meshiti.lead: Dulygaly mosque is located in Ulytau district of Karaganda region, on the river Ashyly, 135 km from the village of Karsakpay. The mosque-madrasah, consisting of 24 rooms with a red brick exterior, was built by Kulmukhambet Arystanbayuli (about 1902-1906), who lived along the Dulygaly and Ashly rivers.
dulygaly-meshiti.bodyHtml:
Dulygaly mosque is located in Ulytau district of Karaganda region, on the river Ashyly, 135 km from the village of Karsakpay. The mosque-madrasah, consisting of 24 rooms with a red brick exterior, was built by Kulmukhambet Arystanbayuli (about 1902-1906), who lived along the Dulygaly and Ashly rivers.Kulmukhambet Arystanbayuli Ishan was a very religious and talented person.

His father sent him to study in Bukhara and Samarkand to learn Arabic at a young age. From there he receives a letter on the level of Quran and Ishan. He works in a mosque in the largest center of the country and gains experience. He also specialized in medicine, jewelry, carpentry, construction. Seeking to teach the art of collecting abroad, he returned to the country only sixteen years later. Ishan built mosques and madrassas in the country, taught children and helped to open the religious literacy of the people.The master who built the mosque was Berdykei Talpak. The project of the mosque was designed by Kulmukhambet Ishan with 9 domes on the model of Bukhara. He took part in the casting of each brick, painted Arabic inscriptions on it and decorated it with ornaments. Ishan had been cutting the mold for three years. He also took part in the construction of a kiln. As soon as the mold was ready, it was immediately poured into pieces and baked. After the mosque, a 24-room madrasah will be built. The roofing timber and floorboards were transported from Aman-Karagai and Nauryz by a bullock cart. Construction was completed in 1920. Until then, children studied in the mosque. A specially invited Tatar named Galiulla teaches Russian. When the national liberation uprising broke out in 1916, rebel members of the Kipchak tribe reportedly gathered here and made plans for the future.From 1937 to 1938, the mosque was kept in good condition, and then the bricks were taken to the collective farm. Kulmukhambet Ishan probably died before 1916. His successors were Abdrakhman Ishan and Birmagambet Ishan.

References: 1. Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –253 p; 2. The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume 3 –Astana, 2019. –136 p.

zhuban-ana-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Zhuban Ana
zhuban-ana-kesenesi.fact: Zhanaarka district of Karaganda region is an architectural monument of the XI century, located on a hill on the right…
zhuban-ana-kesenesi.lead: Zhanaarka district of Karaganda region is an architectural monument of the XI century, located on a hill on the right bank of the river Sarysu, 2 km northeast of the 189th railroads passing track.There are several historical legends about the mausoleum of Zhuban Ana.
zhuban-ana-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
Zhanaarka district of Karaganda region is an architectural monument of the XI century, located on a hill on the right bank of the river Sarysu, 2 km northeast of the 189th railroads passing track.There are several historical legends about the mausoleum of Zhuban Ana.

First of all, this mausoleum has been revered as a "holy tomb" since the Middle Ages. According to historical legends, Talmas Ata lived on the Sarysu River during the Golden Horde. Talmas Ata probably had Zhelmaya's camel. On the first day, he stopped at Zhuban ana mausoleum, and then along the Sarysu he greeted the mothers Bolgan and Belen. Zhelmaya camel is blowing in the wind on the shores of Zhetykonyr sand and Sarysu. The mausoleum has been revered by the people until recently. A passenger landed on his head and came to visit the goddess to ask for a child. It is a dome, four- and octagonal single-chamber construction. The mausoleum is made of baked bricks 27x27x6 cm. The main weight-bearing structure of the monument is made of burnt and untreated bricks. The first written record of the mausoleum of Zhuban Ana was found in published in 1762 work of P.I. Rychkov's "Topography of Orenburg". He was the first to photograph the project and paint the mausoleum in 1863. It is known that it was Chokan Valikhanov. In 1946, the mausoleum was studied by the Central-Kazakhstan archeological expedition of the Academy of Sciences of the Kazakh SSR (A.H. Margulan). In 1974, the expedition of the Ministry of the Kazakh SSR measured the monument and fixed the picture.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –173-174 pp.

maqat-saganasy.name: Sagana of Makat
maqat-saganasy.fact: Sagana, built for Makat Sarzhanuli, is an architectural monument of Central Kazakhstan, built in the early ХІХ and…
maqat-saganasy.lead: Sagana, built for Makat Sarzhanuli, is an architectural monument of Central Kazakhstan, built in the early ХІХ and late ХХ centuries. Sagana is located 10 km north-west of Shenber aul of Ulytau district of Karaganda region, on the banks of the river Karatorgai.Makat Sarzhanuli is said to have been a rich and well-educated man who lived in the Turgai region bordering Ulytau.
maqat-saganasy.bodyHtml:
Sagana, built for Makat Sarzhanuli, is an architectural monument of Central Kazakhstan, built in the early ХІХ and late ХХ centuries. Sagana is located 10 km north-west of Shenber aul of Ulytau district of Karaganda region, on the banks of the river Karatorgai.Makat Sarzhanuli is said to have been a rich and well-educated man who lived in the Turgai region bordering Ulytau. He made special cameras under the mausoleum, thinking that he and his descendants would live together.The descendants of the ancestor are buried in the open tomb inside Sagan.

It is estimated that there are about twenty bodies. The last body was buried here in 1994. Interestingly, the funeral tradition here is different. When a person died, his body was wrapped in a white cloth and taken to a specially dug place in the basement of the tomb. Men and women have separate rooms. And in the middle, there is a curtain. If the deceased entrusts his body to be buried here, the body will be unloaded at a special excavation site. Surprisingly, the corpse here does not smell for forty days in July. The door is covered with felt, so it may not be hot in summer. The inner walls of the cold brown place are made of brick. In winter and summer the temperature inside is stable.Sagana is a single-chamber dome-portal, built of burnt brick. The main facade is decorated with bricks of different shapes. The conical dome is mounted on a round base. The main facade is decorated with a “P” -shaped strip, with an arched entrance in the middle. The three walls are decorated with a “S” -shaped pattern, resembling a carpet. Stairs are installed on the inner wall of the main facade. Through the corridor you can descend the stairs to the grave to a depth of 1 m.

References: 1. Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –275 p; 2. The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume 3 –Astana, 2019. –167-p.

tattimbet-qazangapuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Tattimbet Kazangapuly
tattimbet-qazangapuly-kesenesi.fact: Karaganda region is located in the valley between the Babaly and Arkalyk mountains, along the North River in the…
tattimbet-qazangapuly-kesenesi.lead: Karaganda region is located in the valley between the Babaly and Arkalyk mountains, along the North River in the Karkaralinsk region. In one of the three cradles inside the mausoleum lies his father Kazangap, in the second Tattimbet's mother Kalayi, and in the third Tattimbet.
tattimbet-qazangapuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
Karaganda region is located in the valley between the Babaly and Arkalyk mountains, along the North River in the Karkaralinsk region. In one of the three cradles inside the mausoleum lies his father Kazangap, in the second Tattimbet's mother Kalayi, and in the third Tattimbet.Tattimbet Kazangapuly (1815-1862) - kuishi-composer, dombra player, one of the founders of the school of shertpe kui performance, a classic of folk kui art.

In 1855, Tattimbet was received by a delegation of Western Siberian Kyrgyz (Kazakhs), Tsar Alexander II. He performed several kiuis in this reception. Each of Tattimbet's following kiuis “Bylkyldak”, “Shayirkaldy”, “Saryozen”, “Alshagyr”, “Kokeikesty”, “Sarzhailau” have their own origin and style of performance. All these kiuis are dedicated to Saryarka. Ethnographer, scientist, writer, art critic Akseleu Seidimbek in his encyclopedic work “Kazakh kui art” considers Tattimbet as a great kuishi who formed the tradition of Kazakh brown kuis and pioneered the establishment of a whole school of kui.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –383-385-pp.

shanyshqyly-berdiqozha-kesenesi.name: The Mausoleum of Shanyshkyly Berdykozha
shanyshqyly-berdiqozha-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Shanyshkyly Berdykozha is located in Temirshi aul of Karkaralinsk district of Karaganda…
shanyshqyly-berdiqozha-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Shanyshkyly Berdykozha is located in Temirshi aul of Karkaralinsk district of Karaganda region.Shanyshkyly Berdykozha batyr (1685-1786) was one of the heroes who fought in the battle against the Dzungars in the time of Abylai.
shanyshqyly-berdiqozha-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Shanyshkyly Berdykozha is located in Temirshi aul of Karkaralinsk district of Karaganda region.Shanyshkyly Berdykozha batyr (1685-1786) was one of the heroes who fought in the battle against the Dzungars in the time of Abylai. According to historical data, Berdykozha did not hold a khan's meeting without a hero, nor he went on a campaign.

Berdykozha Batyr fought in the battles of Ayagoz, Bulanty-Bileuti and Sarysu rivers, Talky, Emba, Alakol, Ulanasu, Kandysu, Aidynsu, Shar, Shorga in Altai, near Kozymanyrak, Koimanyrak, Akshauli, Itishpes lakes, Anyrak.There are various reports about the death of the hero. In defense of the country's interests, Berdykozha is constantly on the march, often fighting in bloody battles with Bogenbai, Karakerei Kabanbai, Alban Raimbek, Naiman Kokzharly Barak, Baigozy Tarakty, Zharylgap Karakesek and Zhaugash Batyr. According to Mashkhur-Zhussup, when he found out that he was going to be killed by the enemy, he said to his wife: –I was left in the land of the enemy, you will not be able to take away my body, cut my one finger, bury it in your neighborhood and build a building, call it “Building of Berdykozha”. Those who remember me will pray”.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –310-312-pp.

shortanbai-qanaiuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Shortanbay Kanayuly
shortanbai-qanaiuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Shortanbay is located 6 km south-west of Aksu Ayuly aul of Shet district.
shortanbai-qanaiuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Shortanbay is located 6 km south-west of Aksu Ayuly aul of Shet district. Shortanbay Kanayuli (1818-1881) is a Tokpe poet who sang the truth of his time, one of the greatest representatives of the famous period in Kazakh literature called “Zar Zaman”.
shortanbai-qanaiuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Shortanbay is located 6 km south-west of Aksu Ayuly aul of Shet district. Shortanbay Kanayuli (1818-1881) is a Tokpe poet who sang the truth of his time, one of the greatest representatives of the famous period in Kazakh literature called “Zar Zaman”.

He devoted his entire conscious life and poetic talent to singing about the plight of the his people under colonial oppression, about its future, to feel the diseases of the times he witnessed, and to take part in their ruthless denunciation. The poet met the needs of not only a certain environment or region, but the whole nation, and was a mourner of many.The first publisher of the poet's poems was academician V.Radlov. Shortanbay's collection of poems was published in Kazan, and during the Soviet era his works were published in various collections. “Shortanbay's childhood cry” (October, 1888-1916), “Zar zaman”, “Zaman akyr” in the collections of VVRadlov, "Erden batyrga aytkany" published in Y. Altynsarin's chrestomathy (1879). Thoughts and aitys in the Soviet era were published in S. Seifullin's “Old Literature Versions” (1931), S. Mukanov, K. Bekhozhin's “Reader of Kazakh Literature” (1942), “Aitys” (1965). According to the legend, at the time of Shortanbay Zhyrau's death, he told the good people of the country: “Don't put me in my bed, the time will come when I will degrade the country. It is better that not many people know where I am. “According to the plan, the mausoleum is round and domed. The inside of the dome is fixed with wooden poles. A wooden pole also supports the entrance door. Inside the cell, in the corners, there are arched cavities”.

References: 1. Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –271 p; 2. The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume 3 –Astana, 2019. –190-p.

aqmeshit-meshiti.name: White Mosque
aqmeshit-meshiti.fact: The religious object is located on Al-Farabi Avenue, Kostanay.A building called the Muslim Mosque or Akmeshit dates…
aqmeshit-meshiti.lead: The religious object is located on Al-Farabi Avenue, Kostanay.A building called the Muslim Mosque or Akmeshit dates back to the XIX century. The end is a unique religious architectural monument.
aqmeshit-meshiti.bodyHtml:
The religious object is located on Al-Farabi Avenue, Kostanay.A building called the Muslim Mosque or Akmeshit dates back to the XIX century. The end is a unique religious architectural monument. The mosque was built at the expense of local charity. The main funds for the new mosque were collected by rich Kazakhs such as Minaradar Kylyshbayev, Esentai Haji, Nurzhan akyn, Karim, Leker Haji from Arakaragai volost, and sent to the well-known Tatar merchant Abduali Ahmedhanuli Yaushev, a representative of the Yaushev Brothers trading house in Troitsk. Then the construction materials begin to arrive. About 1,000 people took part in the construction of the mosque. Specialists, artists from St. Petersburg and masters from Kazan were invited to create and decorate the pattern. Their accommodation and food will be provided by Arakaragai volost. In 1893, the construction of the mosque was completed and put into operation.The mosque is built of burnt bricks. The area of the mosque is 844.3 square meters, one-minaret, two-storey, the height of the dome is 18,890 square meters, the height of the minaret is 22,745, for 1000 people. The building of the mosque is 6 m high. The semi-circular protrusion of the mosque ends with a high minaret calling for the call to prayer.Until 1930, the mosque served all Muslims. During the Soviet era, the mosque was used as a club. During the Second World War, the building housed an evacuation point, and after the war there was a GKKT (cinema for young spectators). In 1980-1991, the building housed the regional philharmonic. On November 1, 1991, the mosque was returned to the people. In 2002, the mosque was named after a prominent religious scholar Maral Ishan Kurmanuli.

References: Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –287 p; The sacred Kazakhstan, Volume 3 –Astana: 2019. –201- p.

abdigappar-zhanbosynuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Abdigappar Zhanbosynuli
abdigappar-zhanbosynuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum is located near the aul of Zhanakala, Amangeldy district, Kostanay region.
abdigappar-zhanbosynuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum is located near the aul of Zhanakala, Amangeldy district, Kostanay region. Abdygappar Zhanbosynuli (1870-1919) - the leader of the national liberation movement of the Kazakh people in 1916-1917 in the Turgai steppe.
abdigappar-zhanbosynuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum is located near the aul of Zhanakala, Amangeldy district, Kostanay region. Abdygappar Zhanbosynuli (1870-1919) - the leader of the national liberation movement of the Kazakh people in 1916-1917 in the Turgai steppe.Abdygappar Zhanbosynuli is a descendant of Tleuli Batyr. He considered the country of Turgai, which he ruled, as an autonomous region with the right to live temporarily in times of war, which did not recognize the authority of the metropolis until the establishment of an independent Kazakh state. Prior to the events of 1916, he was respected by his countrymen, engaged in irrigated agriculture and opened a school in his village. On November 21, 1916, representatives of the residents of 13 volosts elected Abdygappar Zhanbosynuli khan at the constituent assembly. During the national liberation movement of 1916, using his great influence and authority in the steppe, he helped unite thousands of troops under A.Imanov's banner. Abdygappar led the rebels through a 20-member council. Abdygappar took part in the First Congress of Soviets (Orenburg, March 1918) and later refused to pursue the policy of the Soviet government. Abdigappar, who was on horseback on the way to freedom, was killed by the Red Army in the Zaure thicket.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. – 420-422-pp.

aulie-nikolskii-shirkeui.name: Saint Nickolsky Church
aulie-nikolskii-shirkeui.fact: The church is located in Presnogorkov aul of Uzunkol district of Kostanay region.Preserved in the territory of North…
aulie-nikolskii-shirkeui.lead: The church is located in Presnogorkov aul of Uzunkol district of Kostanay region.Preserved in the territory of North Kazakhstan in the XIX century. One of the oldest Orthodox churches in the beginning.
aulie-nikolskii-shirkeui.bodyHtml:
The church is located in Presnogorkov aul of Uzunkol district of Kostanay region.Preserved in the territory of North Kazakhstan in the XIX century. One of the oldest Orthodox churches in the beginning.The church was built of crushed stone and burnt brick in 1799 with the help of local residents. During construction, a special mixture of egg white and alabaster was used. The stone church is dedicated to Saint Nicholas the Wonderworker and the Mother of God of Kazan, and consists of two summer and winter parts, surrounded by a wooden fence. Near the walls of the church is the grave of Lieutenant General Vasily Ivanovich de Saint Laurent, the head of the Omsk regional administration, who died suddenly in 1835 while touring the region.From the memoirs of YF Ermolaev (born in 1926): “Nikolsky Church was located in the central square. A magnificent architectural building with a large and a small church tower. Bells of various shapes hung on the four sides of the big tower. On the north side - the largest bell, cast in 1678, on the east - 2 bells, on the west - 8 small bells. The second tower is lower than the first and is located in the eastern part of the church. The roof was covered with tin and shone like new. ” In 1938 the church was closed and turned into a granary. In 1991, the church was partially renovated and reopened.

References: Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –289 p; The sacred Kazakhstan, Volume 3 –Astana: 2019. –207- p.

baimyrza-aulie-tenizbaiulynyn-kesenesi.name: The Mausoleum of Baymyrza Saint Tenizbayuli
baimyrza-aulie-tenizbaiulynyn-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Saint. Baimyrza Tengizbayuli is one of the sacred places in Zhangeldin district of Kostanay region.
baimyrza-aulie-tenizbaiulynyn-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Saint. Baimyrza Tengizbayuli is one of the sacred places in Zhangeldin district of Kostanay region. Kalam-Karasu rural district is located in Shubalan aul.Baimyrza Tengizbayuli (1741-1829) was a hero who led the struggle against the colonial policy of the imperial authorities.
baimyrza-aulie-tenizbaiulynyn-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Saint. Baimyrza Tengizbayuli is one of the sacred places in Zhangeldin district of Kostanay region. Kalam-Karasu rural district is located in Shubalan aul.Baimyrza Tengizbayuli (1741-1829) was a hero who led the struggle against the colonial policy of the imperial authorities. His father Tengizbay Babasuli was a hero who knelt down with Malaysari and defended the Great Zhuz from the Dzungars. Baimyrza lost his father in his 13. When his father inherited 6 sons, Baimyrza inherited 12 whips and five weapons. He intends to take part in the “Giving Life” sentence, on which his brother was sentenced by judges to pay for killing a 13 years old thief.

Then Urkimbay bi from Argyn tribe presented his “Akmonshak” tulpar to Baimyrza and blessed him: “If you vomit on this horse, you will get rid of it, if you run away, you will be saved, may the spirit of your ancestors support you”. When Baimyrza came to the top of Karasha hill on horseback with a representative spear in his hand and a spear in his hand, the wise elder of the opposite side said: “This boy is very spirited. At the base of his spear lies a tiger with six fangs and a strong back. Let's come to an agreement without bloodshed. However, the disgruntled group resisted and released three undefeated heroes. Baimyrza pinned one of them with a spear and bled to death. From this incident he was a hero who became famous for his heroism and later became a hero. Baimyrza also supported the uprising of E. Pugachev in neighboring Russia. Historian E. Bekmakhanov writes that Baimyrza and E.Pugachev corresponded and communicated. This fact proves that Baimyrza was dissatisfied with the colonial policy of the Russian government. Due to the hero's vision and ability to cure various nervous diseases, people called Baimyrza Batyr “Saint Baimyrza” during his lifetime. There is a saying among the people: “Baimyrza is as blessed as a straw”. In essence, Baimyrza was a hospitable man who did not set the table and did not leave his house, even if he was not a rich man. The mausoleum of Saint Baimyrza has been a “sacred mazar” for several centuries. The sign on the head of the saint is still well preserved and has become a sacred place of pilgrimage.

References: 1. Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –282- p;2. In the footsteps of ancestors (Chronicle of the Mergen clan): –Astana: Saryarka, 2013. –384 p.

  1. The sacred Kazakhstan, Volume 3 –Astana: 2019. –208 p.

baraq-zhanuzaquly-qarabaluanuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Barak Zhanuzakuly (Karabaluanuli)
baraq-zhanuzaquly-qarabaluanuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of this hero is located 10 km from Sarykol district of Kostanay region.
baraq-zhanuzaquly-qarabaluanuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of this hero is located 10 km from Sarykol district of Kostanay region. Barak Zhanuzakuli (Karabaluanuli) was born and lived in about XVII (year of birth 1696, according to some sources 1722) - XVIII centuries.
baraq-zhanuzaquly-qarabaluanuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of this hero is located 10 km from Sarykol district of Kostanay region. Barak Zhanuzakuli (Karabaluanuli) was born and lived in about XVII (year of birth 1696, according to some sources 1722) - XVIII centuries. His father was a camel wrestler and known as Zhanuzakuli Karabaluan. In 1740-1758, Barak Batyr took part in the Ordabasy gathering, the battles of Bulanty and Anyrakai for the liberation of the Kazakh lands from the Kalmyk invaders. He is known for his insight, healing and strength. Abylai was with the khan and justified the khan's trust. He defended the fortresses between the Kazakh and Russian lands and ensured the prevention of war on Kazakh lands. Abylaikhan was very pleased with Barak and said: “You are a hero, you are a saint. People called you a healer and a shaman. "I say 'Auliye-batyr,'" he said.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –314-316-pp.

zhauke-nazargululy-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Zhauke Nazargululi
zhauke-nazargululy-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Zhauke Batyr is located in Sarytogai aul of Amangeldy district of Kostanay region.
zhauke-nazargululy-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Zhauke Batyr is located in Sarytogai aul of Amangeldy district of Kostanay region. Zhauke Nazargululi (1822-1904) - a hero who fought against the colonial policy of the Russian Empire.
zhauke-nazargululy-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Zhauke Batyr is located in Sarytogai aul of Amangeldy district of Kostanay region. Zhauke Nazargululi (1822-1904) - a hero who fought against the colonial policy of the Russian Empire. He joined Kenesary Kassymov's uprising after 1838 and he was prominent in the capture of the Akmola fortress. Soldiers under the command of Zhauke Batyr were one of the first to enter the fortress. Later he captured the fortresses of Aktau and Or. In 1842, due to the perseverance and confidence of Iman and Zhauke batyrs, Kenesary Kasymuly spent the winter on the banks of the Turgai. Later Kenesary Khan's horde was moved here.Kenesary's soldiers were especially prominent in the clashes with the colonizers on the Ulkeyek River, in the settlements of Tolybai and Balapan, in the war against the detachment of the Russian government Akhmet Zhanturin in 1844, during the attack on Ekaterinsk station. The hero, who cared about the people, was honored by the country for his justice and wisdom.Well-known historian Ermukhan Bekmakhanov's study “National liberation uprising led by Kenesary Kasymuli” mentions the name of Zhauke Batyr, in the novel-trilogy “Nomads” by Ilyas Esenberlin, in the epic “Crow” by the poet Nurkhan Akhmetbekov.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –374-376-pp.

qutan-aulie-atalyquly-kesenesi.name: Kutan Aulie Atalykuli Mausoleum
qutan-aulie-atalyquly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum is a religious object located near the aul of Amantogai, Amangeldy district, Kostanay region, near the…
qutan-aulie-atalyquly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum is a religious object located near the aul of Amantogai, Amangeldy district, Kostanay region, near the river Karynsaldy. The mausoleum was rebuilt in 2008 by the descendants of Saint Kutan.
qutan-aulie-atalyquly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum is a religious object located near the aul of Amantogai, Amangeldy district, Kostanay region, near the river Karynsaldy. The mausoleum was rebuilt in 2008 by the descendants of Saint Kutan.Kutan (real name Kuttybay) Atalykuli (about 1670–1790) - saint, seer, healer, ambassador, bi. He was born in Ulytau region. His father Atalyk was a famous hero during the reign of Zhangir Khan. Kutan Baba has been a priest since childhood. He devoted all his life to the health of the people and the destiny of the country and the land. In the time of Abylai Khan, Kutan was an advisor to the saint khan, a bi.Historically, Tauke Khan sent embassies five times in a row in 1686-1695, trying to get closer to the Russian state, hoping to move the capital to Ulytau and support the war with the Dzungars. Kuttybay, the son of the father, in 1695 headed the embassy of the Kazakh Khanate to the Russian people. This event is written in golden letters in the history of diplomatic policy of the nomadic country.The name of Kuttybay (Kutan), who was brought up by his father Atalyk, experienced people around the khan, such as Orazai, was widely known in the Kazakh steppes at that time. The people's love and respect for such a great figure, who has a special place in the history of the Kazakh people, is a sign that the country called Kuttybay Kutan. Today, a branch of the Aktas clan, which settled in the Kichitau-Ulytau region, is called Kutan. Information about Kuttybay (Kutan) is given in the works of such well-known scholars as M. Karatayev, H. Suinshaliev, M. Magauin, A. Seidimbek, in the ancient literature, in the genealogy of the country, sometimes he is called Kuttybay, sometimes Kutan, known to the locals as Kutan aulie. Well-known writer, ethnographer and scientist S. Kenzheakhmetov became the object of research in connection with the problems of local lore.According to the commandment of Kutan bi: "Bury in the place of exhaustion", in the spring, when the country was moving to the pastures of Tobol-Kushmurun, the leader died and his body was buried here. According to folklore and genealogy, Kutan died at the age of ninety.The people of Turgai have a special respect for the dancer and saint Kutan. Sick and infertile women spend the night at the head of his tomb as a sanctuary, praying and asking for mercy for healing and stabbing.

References: 1. Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –281- p;2. The sacred Kazakhstan, Volume 3 –Astana: 2019. –227 p.

mirzhaqyp-dulatuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Mirzhakyp Dulatuly
mirzhaqyp-dulatuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of the outstanding Kazakh educator, public figure, poet, writer Mirzhakyp Dulatuli (1885-1935) was built…
mirzhaqyp-dulatuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of the outstanding Kazakh educator, public figure, poet, writer Mirzhakyp Dulatuli (1885-1935) was built in 1992 in the aul of Kyzbel (Bidayik) Bidayik, Zhangeldin district, Kostanay region.
mirzhaqyp-dulatuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of the outstanding Kazakh educator, public figure, poet, writer Mirzhakyp Dulatuli (1885-1935) was built in 1992 in the aul of Kyzbel (Bidayik) Bidayik, Zhangeldin district, Kostanay region. Mirzhakyp Dulatov was arrested in 1928 by a group of Kazakh intellectuals and sentenced to ten years, died in captivity in Karelia. At the initiative of his daughter Gulnar Dulatova, his body was delivered to his hometown in 1992 and buried at the site of the mausoleum.One of the leaders of Alash, Mirzhakyp Dulatov, who awakened the Kazakh people in the early twentieth century with a fiery song, called for art, knowledge and freedom, in his poems openly opposed the tsar's colonial policy and fought against lawbreakers who oppressed the black people. He demanded that the government open a school for Kazakh youth and publish newspapers and magazines in the Kazakh language. His ideas were further developed in the works of Kazakh intellectuals in the early twentieth century. For example, “Wake up, Kazakh!” The song became the hymn of the Kazakh youth.
