satybaldy-ishan-gabdollauly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Satybaldy Ishan Gabdollauly
satybaldy-ishan-gabdollauly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Satybaldy Ishan is located in Amangeldy aul, Amangeldy district, Kostanay region.The mausoleum was…
satybaldy-ishan-gabdollauly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Satybaldy Ishan is located in Amangeldy aul, Amangeldy district, Kostanay region.The mausoleum was built in 1899 by masters from Tashkent, the eldest son of Satybaldy Ishan Myrza Ishan.
satybaldy-ishan-gabdollauly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Satybaldy Ishan is located in Amangeldy aul, Amangeldy district, Kostanay region.The mausoleum was built in 1899 by masters from Tashkent, the eldest son of Satybaldy Ishan Myrza Ishan. A religious monument with two domes and a portal. People call it "Satybaldy ishan tamy" or "Faizolla ishan mazar". Satybaldy Ishan (nickname - Kipchak Ishan) (1826-1898) was a scholar who devoted his entire life to the propagation of religion. He was born in Shoman Karasui village of Kaidauyl volost in Turgai district. As a child he dreamed and said that he was going to study. Although he lost his parents at a young age, thanks to his sister Mugalima, he learned to read from a village mullah and went to Tashkent with the permission of his adopted father Shomak. After a long journey, he experienced many difficulties and hardships and entered a madrasah. Then he was sent to Bukhara to study at Kokiltash madrasah as an enthusiastic student. He studied hard for fourteen years, mastered the Koran, passed the Central Asian Muslim Council with honors and received the title of "Ishan". In 1862, he made a pilgrimage to Mecca-Medina and gained great prestige. His religious knowledge spread to the whole region, including Kazakhstan, to his native Turgai region. Upon hearing this, the ruler of Turgai, Suleimen Tore, invited Satybaldy to the country. Ishan leads the country to morality, builds mosques and madrassas and educates young people in Islam. He was the chief religious leader of the Turgai region. There are many legends about his special qualities. Satybaldy Ishan Gabdullauli taught his compatriots the basics of Islam in his homeland, as well as many of the wisdom he learned while abroad.Satybaldy Ishan had a great contribution to the spread of Islam in the Turgai region, the education of the people in morality, decency, morality, honesty and purity. He was considered a saint after his death. Along with Satybaldy Ishan, his son, the poet Faizolla Satybaldiyuli and his friend Omar Kalpe Tepekuly were buried in this mausoleum.

References: Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –285- p; The sacred Kazakhstan, Volume 3 –Astana: 2019. –240 p.

buqarbai-batyr-estekbaiuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Bukharbai Estekbayuli
buqarbai-batyr-estekbaiuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Bukarbai Batyr is located 21 km northeast of Karaketken aul of Zhalagash district of Kyzylorda region.
buqarbai-batyr-estekbaiuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Bukarbai Batyr is located 21 km northeast of Karaketken aul of Zhalagash district of Kyzylorda region. Due to poor preservation, the mausoleum was renovated in 1993.
buqarbai-batyr-estekbaiuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Bukarbai Batyr is located 21 km northeast of Karaketken aul of Zhalagash district of Kyzylorda region. Due to poor preservation, the mausoleum was renovated in 1993. Bukarbay Estekbayuli (1812-1898) - a hero, participated in the Kenesary uprising, was the leader of the uprisings of the Kokand Khanate. He took part in the capture of the Akmola fortress in August 1838. He was one of the organizers of the attack on the Kokand fortresses of the Kenesary army, including the liberation of the fortress of Suzak. Bukharbai batyr was a companion of Kenesary khan until his death in April 1847.In 1850, Bukarbay's troops attacked the fortresses of Kazaly, Aral, Koskorgan and defeated the Cossack-Russians and Kokand. In 1852, in the struggle against Bukhanbay Batyr's troops against the prince of Khiva, Kozhaniyaz, he broke down the Karaboget dam and flooded the Kuandarya, where the canal was blocked. He fought against the Kokands in the liberation of the Kazakh lands from the Kokand invaders, recognized the supreme power of the Russian Empire and assisted the tsarist army in the conquest of the fortress of Akmeshit. In one of the battles with Kokand, Bukarbay Batyr was seriously wounded. He received awards from the tsarist government for his participation in military campaigns against the Kokand Khanate. Towards the end of his life, he lived in a rural area and engaged in peaceful farming.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –376-378-pp.

zhanqozha-batyr-kesenesi.name: The Mausoleum of Zhankozha Nurmukhameduli
zhanqozha-batyr-kesenesi.fact: It is located in Aiteke bi village of Kazaly district of Kyzylorda region.
zhanqozha-batyr-kesenesi.lead: It is located in Aiteke bi village of Kazaly district of Kyzylorda region. Batyr's burial place is 150 km from Kaukey aul of Kazaly district. Dzhankozha Nurmukhameduli (1774-1860) - the leader of the national liberation uprising of the Kazakhs against the oppression of the Khiva and Kokand khanates and Russian colonizers.
zhanqozha-batyr-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
It is located in Aiteke bi village of Kazaly district of Kyzylorda region. Batyr's burial place is 150 km from Kaukey aul of Kazaly district. Dzhankozha Nurmukhameduli (1774-1860) - the leader of the national liberation uprising of the Kazakhs against the oppression of the Khiva and Kokand khanates and Russian colonizers. Khiva, which began to dominate the Kazakhs living along the Syr Darya and the eastern shores of the Aral Sea in the 1920s, opposed the tyranny of the Kokand khanates and thought about the integrity of our people and the unity of our country. The heroism of Dzhankozha Batyr is widespread among the people.There are many stories about the joint attacks of Zhankozha Batyr with the last Kazakh khan - Kenesary, who came to capture the Suzak fortress. This time, Batyr and his men first came across the Kokand army, which was coming to the aid of the Suzak fortress, defeated them and drove them back. Then he returned to Suzak, Kenesary knelt down and captured the fortress. It was the soldiers of this Dzhankozha batyr who broke down the gates of the fortress and entered first.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –353-355-pp.

oqshy-ata-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Okshi Ata
oqshy-ata-kesenesi.fact: It is located at 20 crossings of Shieli district of Kyzylorda region, at the railway junction 7 km from the aul of…
oqshy-ata-kesenesi.lead: It is located at 20 crossings of Shieli district of Kyzylorda region, at the railway junction 7 km from the aul of Zhulek. The mausoleum of Okshi Ata is the burial place of seven saints.
oqshy-ata-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
It is located at 20 crossings of Shieli district of Kyzylorda region, at the railway junction 7 km from the aul of Zhulek. The mausoleum of Okshi Ata is the burial place of seven saints. Okshi Ata is a monument of the Oguz period, a sacred mausoleum on the head of the hero. Okshi Ata is a saint from the Syr region. His real name is Ibrahim, Okshi is the name given by the people. He was awarded the title of sniper. According to the legend, when shooting with wheat, it hits the chest. Okshi Ata was orphaned at a young age and became a representative of a paralytic and an old woman. One day he asked his adoptive parents to greet Hodja Ahmed Yassavi and return. At that time, Akmeshit khan, in addition to collecting taxes from the country, in turn demanded that everyone bring a girl. His parents said to our grandfather Okshy: - What will happen to us if your sister is taken away by the khan when you leave? - says. The man said calmly, “Just shout my name three times, and I'll be right there”. By the way, one day the khans and nobles came to the settlement where Oksha Ata lived. At that moment, when his father shouted his name three times, the khan fell on the horse and fell to the ground. Everyone is shouting, “I killed the khan”. - People, let's not give drugs in vain, you can tell who shot the khan from the stalk of barley stuck in his heart. If I destroyed his eyes, he would have barley in his heart, - says Okshy Ata. That is exactly what happened.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –268-270 pp.

hristos-spasitel-shirkeui.name: Christ Savior Church
hristos-spasitel-shirkeui.fact: The church is located on I. Toktybayev Street in Kyzylorda.
hristos-spasitel-shirkeui.lead: The church is located on I. Toktybayev Street in Kyzylorda. The first mobile church in Perovsk (Kyzylorda) was opened on October 13, 1855, and a permanent church was opened in 1863.
hristos-spasitel-shirkeui.bodyHtml:
The church is located on I. Toktybayev Street in Kyzylorda. The first mobile church in Perovsk (Kyzylorda) was opened on October 13, 1855, and a permanent church was opened in 1863. Its founder is L. Gorokhovsky.In 1896, a new church building was built and put into operation. 250-300 people can pray freely in the church. The church building consists of two parts - a prayer hall and an entrance. The main size is a cross-domed cross, the crosses are equal, there are additional rooms in the entrance corners of the cross. This cross-shaped space is high (two candles), the middle cross is divided into two parts. The semicircular arch on an octagonal drum is cut by eight narrow window openings. The sleeves of the cross are covered with semi-circular domes that form the shape of the facades. At the top of these parts are high-proportion three-part windows covered with semicircular arches. The door to the prayer hall is on the west side. It is adorned with a dome with two candlesticks, an octagonal dome under the drum. The interior is divided into two levels by a border bar.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –292-293-pp.

baluaniiaz-musirepuly-kesenesi.name: The Mausoleum of Baluaniyaz Musirepuli
baluaniiaz-musirepuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Baluaniyaz Musrepuli is located 100 km east of the village of Senek, Karakiya district, Mangistau…
baluaniiaz-musirepuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Baluaniyaz Musrepuli is located 100 km east of the village of Senek, Karakiya district, Mangistau region. Baluaniyaz Musrepuli (1818-1856) is a national hero.
baluaniiaz-musirepuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Baluaniyaz Musrepuli is located 100 km east of the village of Senek, Karakiya district, Mangistau region. Baluaniyaz Musrepuli (1818-1856) is a national hero. He was a hero of the Balykshy clan, a prominent figure in the wars between the Mangystau Aday and Turkmen tribes, the Khiva.Under the pressure of the Russian Empire and the Khiva Khanate, the people of Mangystau strongly opposed the colonial and aggressive policies of the two countries. One of those historical events was the Karagan-Bosaga massacre with the participation of Baluaniyaz Musrepuli. In the summer of 1856, Baluaniyaz Batyr led a small Kazakh detachment (about 60 men) against the Khiva army. In this battle, the hero Baluaniyaz and his brother Korganbek, his comrades Mailybay, Oraz and other heroes died. The hero was buried with his comrades in Karagan Bosaga, where the bloody battle took place. The story on sixty heroes of Adai was heard and recorded by the Kazakh national chronicler, poet Umirzak Kalbayuli Sabyr-Zhyrau Selbayuli.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –364-365-pp.

baraq-satybaldyuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Barak Satybaldyuly
baraq-satybaldyuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum is located in Beineu district of Mangistau region.
baraq-satybaldyuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum is located in Beineu district of Mangistau region. In 1993, a domed mausoleum was built on the tomb of Barak Batyr. The monument is rectangular in shape, with a three-story wall in the style of local traditional architecture.
baraq-satybaldyuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum is located in Beineu district of Mangistau region. In 1993, a domed mausoleum was built on the tomb of Barak Batyr. The monument is rectangular in shape, with a three-story wall in the style of local traditional architecture.Barak Satybaldiuli (1743-1840) - a hero, one of the leaders of the national liberation movement of the Kazakhs of the Lesser Zhuz. Barak Satybaldiuli became a hero at the age of 18 (1761) after defeating the hero of Torgauyt Alakubik. Until the 70s of the XVIII century, the herd fought with the Kalmyks between the Volga and the Urals. In1785-1792, he was one of the leaders of the uprising against Russian colonialism, led by Syrym Datuly. It is mentioned in O. Igelstrom's letter to the Empress Catherine II. Barak Batyr's resistance limited the violence of the Russian colonists and helped to preserve the Kazakh lands on the right bank of the Ural. He prevented the building of construction of many military fortifications on the territory of Western Kazakhstan.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –355-357-pp.

dosan-tazhiuly-kesenesi.name: Dosan Tazhiuli Mausoleum
dosan-tazhiuly-kesenesi.fact: It is located in Karatobe cemetery, 15 km south-east of Shebir village, Mangistau district, Mangistau region.
dosan-tazhiuly-kesenesi.lead: It is located in Karatobe cemetery, 15 km south-east of Shebir village, Mangistau district, Mangistau region. Dosan Tazhiuli (1835-1876) - People's Hero, one of the leaders of the Mangistau uprising.
dosan-tazhiuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
It is located in Karatobe cemetery, 15 km south-east of Shebir village, Mangistau district, Mangistau region. Dosan Tazhiuli (1835-1876) - People's Hero, one of the leaders of the Mangistau uprising. In the spring of 1870, Dosan Tazhiuli and Isa Tlenbayuli launched a national liberation uprising against Russian colonizers. The soldiers led by Dosan defeated the punitive detachment of Lieutenant Colonel Rukin, who had come to collect taxes from the Kazakh people, at Ushauyz. He crossed into the Khiva Khanate, engaged in a fierce battle with a punitive detachment sent from the Caucasus. In 1874, a search party led by Anichkin surrounded the aul of Dosan on the Ustyurt plateau in Samkum and captured the wounded hero. Dosan died in Fort Prison two years later. The body of Dosan Batyr was delivered to Bozashchy by a group of people led by Zhangabyl (father of the national poet Sattigul Zhangabyluli).The heroic deeds of Dosan Batyr were sung by poets Aktaban, Balaoraz, Kalniyaz, Sattigul. People describe Dosan as a very agile, lightning-fast, intelligent and unique person.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –362-364-pp.

isa-tilenbaiuly-kesenesi.name: The Mausoleum of Isa Tlenbayuli
isa-tilenbaiuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum is located in the cemetery "Sarykyz" in Alatorpa, 20 km east of the village Shetpe, Mangistau district…
isa-tilenbaiuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum is located in the cemetery "Sarykyz" in Alatorpa, 20 km east of the village Shetpe, Mangistau district of Mangistau region.
isa-tilenbaiuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum is located in the cemetery "Sarykyz" in Alatorpa, 20 km east of the village Shetpe, Mangistau district of Mangistau region.Isa Tlenbayuli (1829-1909) - a hero, orator, bi, ruler of the country, poet, one of the commanders of the uprising of the Kazakhs of Mangystau in 1869-1872 against the tsarist colonizers. Isa Tlenbayuli along with Dosan Tazhiyev had fought against the reform of the tsarist government for 5 years since 1873. The tsarist government called in troops from the Caucasus, the Volga region, and the Urals, but the insurgents, armed only with rifles and swords, could not resist them. Authorities who wanted to take advantage of his authority in the country pardoned him and gave him a position. Isa Tlenbayevich ruled for about 35 years. He was a good man at heart and could rarely do any harm to anyone. Isa Tlenbayuli's "On the way from Kuyken", "On the way to Khiva", "Mourning Dosandy", "Going to Oyaz", "While being Bolys", etc. His poems were widely spread throughout the country.Isa ata was a ghostly hero, a just bi, a poet, a dog runner, a bird hunter, and a sniper. He created and tuned such runners as "Zhagal at", "Shagadam Konyrat" and brought them from many chaotic races. Although he was not rich, he did not receive any prizes, but he gave them away to others.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –360-3621-pp.

korkembai-ahun-meshiti.name: Korkembay Akhun Mosque
korkembai-ahun-meshiti.fact: Akhun Mosque is located 40 km south-west of Beineu aul, Beineu district, Mangistau region.
korkembai-ahun-meshiti.lead: Akhun Mosque is located 40 km south-west of Beineu aul, Beineu district, Mangistau region. The largest architectural monument of the Mangistau region, built in the XIX century.
korkembai-ahun-meshiti.bodyHtml:
Akhun Mosque is located 40 km south-west of Beineu aul, Beineu district, Mangistau region. The largest architectural monument of the Mangistau region, built in the XIX century. The mosque was built by order of the rich local Akbota Zhemenei.The plan of the mosque is a 22-room rectangular building, built on the lower part of a one-story wall without a foundation, with 28 domes removed from the roof. The mosque is built of bricks, the walls are covered with limestone on the outside, the inner walls are plastered. In the middle of the building there are 4 large halls, rooms with beams and domed roofs along the perimeter are lined up with false columns protruding from the walls.Until 1928, the Korkembay Mosque was called an educational institution, where children of the country were taught Islam. Well-known akhuns and ishans - Abdullah hazrat, Shaudir ishan, Karakalpak Matkarim, etc. taught in the mosque. Bekturlyuli Korkembay Akhun was persecuted by the Bolsheviks, disbanded his disciples, closed his mosque and moved to Tajikistan. It is unknown at this time what year he died and where he was buried.

References: 1. Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –357-p.; 2.The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume-2. –Astana: 2018. –347-p.

qyzylqala-qalashygy.name: Kyzylkala Town
qyzylqala-qalashygy.fact: Mangistau region is located 20 km north-west of the village Shetpe, on the banks of the Akmysh spring.
qyzylqala-qalashygy.lead: Mangistau region is located 20 km north-west of the village Shetpe, on the banks of the Akmysh spring. Chronological period: X-XIII centuries.The size of the monument is 50 hectares. Kyzyl-Kala was a large trade and handicraft city.
qyzylqala-qalashygy.bodyHtml:
Mangistau region is located 20 km north-west of the village Shetpe, on the banks of the Akmysh spring. Chronological period: X-XIII centuries.The size of the monument is 50 hectares. Kyzyl-Kala was a large trade and handicraft city. Surrounding the fortress is a city of merchants and businessmen. The discovery of pottery, baked bricks and fragments of iron, copper, precious metals, stone mills, sickles testify to the existence of factories and the development of ancient farming.The results of the study of individual artifacts found here allow us to determine the import of goods such as Iranian pottery, Egyptian and Chinese beads, Baltic amber. Today, the town square is called Kyzylkala, since it consists of pottery and broken red bricks. In the second half of the XIII century, after the collapse of the Khorezm state from the Mongol invasion, the city lost its economic significance due to the change in sea level and the reorientation of trade routes.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –136-137 pp.

mahtum-baba-meshiti.name: Makhtum Baba Mosque
mahtum-baba-meshiti.fact: Makhtum Baba Mosque is a complex located 25 km east of Fort Shevchenko, Tupkaragan district, Mangistau region.
mahtum-baba-meshiti.lead: Makhtum Baba Mosque is a complex located 25 km east of Fort Shevchenko, Tupkaragan district, Mangistau region. In ancient times, this place was called Kanga Baba gorge.
mahtum-baba-meshiti.bodyHtml:
Makhtum Baba Mosque is a complex located 25 km east of Fort Shevchenko, Tupkaragan district, Mangistau region. In ancient times, this place was called Kanga Baba gorge.The Kanga Baba gorge was an important place on the caravan route from the port of Mangyshlak to Khorezm and Khiva. It has attracted the attention of many travelers and researchers. The complex of monuments is located on the southern slope of the Ustyurt, which is suitable for ancient settlements and gradually turns into a wide valley. Most of the complex (central and eastern part) is covered by ancient Turkmen monuments - mainly stone signs, tombs in the form of "sheep"; box-box; slate fences with built-in tombs; There are also stone signs with candlesticks.Makhtum Baba Mosque was used as a caravanserai building in the Kipchak-Oguz period, and in later centuries it was a school-madrasah. The mosque was a multi-chamber building with large and small rooms.Saint Makhtum Baba, a descendant of Imam Hussein, came to Mangyshlak from the former Persian land inhabited by the Kurekal Turkmens. Soon the disciples began to come to him, and there were many of them. At that time there were no trees in the Kanga area. One day the disciples came to Makhtum Baba and asked for permission to walk in the garden. In response, Makhtum Baba said: “Do not go anywhere today, if you can not find a garden nearby until tomorrow, I will allow you to enter the garden”. The disciples obeyed him, and the next morning they saw that the whole mountain was full of trees. Surprised by this miraculous sight, they came to Makhtum Baba, fell at his feet, and repented of their sins. After that, the number of Makhtum Baba's disciples increased to several thousand. After the death of Makhtum Baba, the gardens were destroyed and only a few mulberry trees have survived.

References: 1. Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –345-p.; 2.The sacred Kazakhstan. Volume-2. –Astana: 2018. –359-p.

arystan-bab-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Arystan Bab
arystan-bab-kesenesi.fact: It is located near the village of Shauldir, Otyrar district, South Kazakhstan region.
arystan-bab-kesenesi.lead: It is located near the village of Shauldir, Otyrar district, South Kazakhstan region. The mausoleum was built in the second quarter of the XIV century.
arystan-bab-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
It is located near the village of Shauldir, Otyrar district, South Kazakhstan region. The mausoleum was built in the second quarter of the XIV century. .The mausoleum was built in the XII century on the burial place of Arystan Bab, a religious figure who was a spiritual teacher of Hodja Ahmed Yassavi. Arystan Bab is a spiritual teacher of Sufis in Otyrar, Sairam, Turkestan (Yasy). The mausoleum of Arystan Bab is a building that has undergone various renovations over the centuries. It is sometimes said that Arystanbab lived in the XI-XII centuries, and his mausoleum was built shortly after the death of Arystanbab. However, there are no signs of the XII century in the modern mausoleum. At the same time, we should keep in mind that Islam initially forbade the construction of a roof over a grave. From this point of view, it is possible that in the XII century there was no Arystan Bab building.In the writings of A. Cherkasov, we mentioned above that the mausoleum of Arystan Bab consisted of two rooms where the saint and his disciples lay, as well as the shed in front. Their design corresponds to the construction of the XIV century.

of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –239-241-pp.

gauhar-ana-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Gaukhar Ana
gauhar-ana-kesenesi.fact: South Kazakhstan region is located 4 km south of Turkestan, 400-500 meters to the left of the highway Turkestan…
gauhar-ana-kesenesi.lead: South Kazakhstan region is located 4 km south of Turkestan, 400-500 meters to the left of the highway Turkestan - Shauldir.Gaukhar Ana mausoleum (XII-XIV centuries) portal-dome construction.
gauhar-ana-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
South Kazakhstan region is located 4 km south of Turkestan, 400-500 meters to the left of the highway Turkestan - Shauldir.Gaukhar Ana mausoleum (XII-XIV centuries) portal-dome construction. Mother Gaukhar is the daughter of the great poet and thinker Hodja Ahmed Yassavi. Legend has it that Mother Gaukhar had a special healing power. It is not known when the mother died, only that she was born in 1122-1124 and died about 1187-97.Legend has it that Gaukhar did not have a mother. The father said that he comforted his daughter by saying, "Everyone who is healed is your child." During tsarist Russia, the monument was destroyed and half of it collapsed. Later, after gaining independence, the mausoleum was repaired and rebuilt. Today the mausoleum of Gaukhar Ana has a lot of visitors. Many are seeking a cure. Talai hopes that the holy mother, who healed the soul, will be rewarded. Some have even recovered from their illness. The mausoleums are architecturally harmonious, mainly for women.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –188-189 pp.

esim-han-kesenesi.name: Mausoleume of Yessym Khan
esim-han-kesenesi.fact: Yessym Khan Mausoleum is an architectural monument of the XVII century, located 12 m south of the western tower of the…
esim-han-kesenesi.lead: Yessym Khan Mausoleum is an architectural monument of the XVII century, located 12 m south of the western tower of the mausoleum of Hodja Ahmed Yassawi in Turkestan, South Kazakhstan region.
esim-han-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
Yessym Khan Mausoleum is an architectural monument of the XVII century, located 12 m south of the western tower of the mausoleum of Hodja Ahmed Yassawi in Turkestan, South Kazakhstan region. The mausoleum was built on the tomb of Yessym Khan, khan of the Kazakh Khanate. It probably collapsed in the late XVIII and early XIX centuries. The preserved part of the mausoleum was renovated in 2000. During the reign of Yesim Khan (1598-1628), who mastered diplomacy, the Kazakh Khanate was strengthened and recaptured much of Dzungarian-Kalmyk territory. In 1598, Turkestan was permanently under the control of the Kazakh Khanate and became the center of the Kazakh Khanate from Yessym Khan. “Tole came to power, Yessym came to the whole khanate”, said Kazybek Biden. Yessym Khan signed a treaty with Bukhara and sought to establish peaceful and economic ties with the cities of Central Asia. He wanted to create the Kazakh Khanate as a centralized state. He drafted a law called “The Old Way of Yessym Khan”.

qazygurt-tau-kesheni.name: Kazygurt Mountain Complex
qazygurt-tau-kesheni.fact: The complex is located 35 km south of Shymkent, the center of the South Kazakhstan region.
qazygurt-tau-kesheni.lead: The complex is located 35 km south of Shymkent, the center of the South Kazakhstan region. One massif of Talas Alatau Kazygurt is 1800 meters high, 20 km long and 10 km wide.
qazygurt-tau-kesheni.bodyHtml:
The complex is located 35 km south of Shymkent, the center of the South Kazakhstan region. One massif of Talas Alatau Kazygurt is 1800 meters high, 20 km long and 10 km wide.

There are many religious myths in world mythology about the “Holy Mountain”, “the world flood”, “Noah's ark”. They are mainly from the Jewish, Christian and Islamic originals. The Kazakh mythological version, based on Islamic parallelism, “There is a ship at the head of Kazygurt” has its own peculiarities.

First, the fact that Noah's ark landed on the top of the mountain is controversial. Because, according to Islamic principles, there should be no arrogance to say, “I am above all”. But the name of the mountain is a mountain, and the ship stopped there, and although it is low, it is considered the holiest of the mountains on earth.

Secondly, it is said that the offspring of the four survivors of the flood grew and multiplied from the head of Kazygurt.

Thirdly, it should be noted that the microtoponyms associated with the ark of Noah are closely related to Kazygurt. On the western side of the top of Kazygurt mountain there is a less flat land. This place is called "the rest of the ship". There are toponyms such as “Noah's Ark Trail”, “Cave where Noah and the people around him lived” after the flood, “The place where the Prophet prayed”, “Five fingerprints” in the cave, “Spring drinking water”.

Fourth, Kazakh mythology says that “when God first created the earth and the sky, the mountain Kazygurt was created together”. Even before the “Noah's Ark” stopped, Kazygurt was visited by saints, so it is interpreted as a “sacred mountain”.

qoshqar-ata-kesenesi-men-bulagy.name: Koshkar Ata Mausoleum and Spring
qoshqar-ata-kesenesi-men-bulagy.fact: Koshkar Ata mausoleum and spring are located on the river Koshkar Ata in Shymkent.According to legends, a boy named…
qoshqar-ata-kesenesi-men-bulagy.lead: Koshkar Ata mausoleum and spring are located on the river Koshkar Ata in Shymkent.According to legends, a boy named Kylysh, who lived in the depths of Karatau in the XI century, was able to study at the age of seven and went to Bukhara.
qoshqar-ata-kesenesi-men-bulagy.bodyHtml:
Koshkar Ata mausoleum and spring are located on the river Koshkar Ata in Shymkent.According to legends, a boy named Kylysh, who lived in the depths of Karatau in the XI century, was able to study at the age of seven and went to Bukhara. In those days there was a blind hero named Arkar (Arkar was the fourth grandfather of the Sword). When he left for school, his parents blessed him and named him, saying, “Even if you are not like your grandfather Arkar, be like a ram, my son”. From then on the Sword became a boy Koshkar.It is said that Kylysh studied in Bukhara for decades, came to his country, opened a mosque and a madrasah, and was the first to build the modern city of Shymkent. There are still more than 10 places where saints are buried in the country. Because almost all the area where he went and opened the spring was surrounded by bricks and mortar, so that ordinary people could not walk on it. It is said that when he was studying in Bukhara, his teacher treated him with special care and respect. Unaware of this, the disciples often pushed the boy away from them. Then one day the teacher took the children to the forest to collect firewood and sent Koshkar to the other side of the river to collect firewood. He did not sink, but slipped on the water and reached the other side. Seeing this, his peers began to look at him differently, realizing that he had a God-given quality.The spring named after Baba starts in the heart of the city, near the railway station. The water from the underground spring bursts through the center of the city and joins the Badam River. At the head of the spring fish swim in groups. People are not so scared to learn. The water of the clear spring is fresh. And the healing properties of spring water is a different story. From the head of the spring in winter and summer there are many human feet. He had water, bathe and was treated.

qyzyr-munarasy.name: Kyzyr Tower
qyzyr-munarasy.fact: The center of Turkestan region is located in Shymkent, on the river Sayramsu. The tower was built in the X century.
qyzyr-munarasy.lead: The center of Turkestan region is located in Shymkent, on the river Sayramsu. The tower was built in the X century. There is an underground road three and a half kilometers south of the tower.
qyzyr-munarasy.bodyHtml:
The center of Turkestan region is located in Shymkent, on the river Sayramsu. The tower was built in the X century. There is an underground road three and a half kilometers south of the tower. In one room of the tower there was a door to the underground passage. This information has long been kept secret from the country. There was a staircase inside the tower.According to the narrations and historical sources, the real name of the Prophet (pbuh) was Ilyas ibn Malkan ibn Amir ibn Shalih ibn Arfahshid ibn Sam ibn Noah. After the conversion of Sairam region to Islam, he built a large minaret and a mosque in the center of the city and named it "Kyzyr" tower in honor of the Prophet. The open-minded clerics considered Kyzyr to be one of the living prophets. It is called Hizr because the color of the place where he is sitting immediately turns green. The green color and the blossoming of the earth are called "hezra" in Arabic. Hizr is known among Muslims as a prophet of water.Kyzyr is one of the prophets of Islam. In some cultures, it is considered to be the guardian of those who travel to the sea, and it is also considered to be the guardian of fire, flood, theft, and snake bites.

mariiam-ana-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Maryam
mariiam-ana-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum is located in Shymkent, the center of Turkestan region.
mariiam-ana-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum is located in Shymkent, the center of Turkestan region. There is a mosque on the right side of the entrance to the cemetery, followed by a cemetery.
mariiam-ana-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum is located in Shymkent, the center of Turkestan region. There is a mosque on the right side of the entrance to the cemetery, followed by a cemetery. Both are named after their mother Mary. There are two types of information in the writings and folk tales that bear the name of Bibi Maryam Ana. One says that Bibi Maryam, the daughter of Hammad Haji, was buried here. From an early age, he worshiped and obeyed the laws of the Shari'a.In 760-770, the army of Abdal-Aziz Bab and Tukty Shashty Aziz Bab led by Isaac Baba came to Sairam and Turkestan to spread Islam. Maryam ana was among them. The prophet blessed Maryam ana. He helped teach women to pray. Maryam also had healing properties.Gaukhar, the oldest and most powerful saint in the Tereskey region, dreamed of her grandmother Bibi Maryam and blessed her with a vision: “you will be well-known among people as a saver of purity, justice and truth”.

nikolskii-shirkeui.name: Nicolski Church
nikolskii-shirkeui.fact: The church is located in Shymkent, the center of Turkestan region.
nikolskii-shirkeui.lead: The church is located in Shymkent, the center of Turkestan region. Its foundation was laid in 1912 and completed in 1914 by the design of the junior architect of the construction department of the Syrdarya region I.A. Markevich, engineers N.I. Botvinkin and R.P. Kochar.
nikolskii-shirkeui.bodyHtml:
The church is located in Shymkent, the center of Turkestan region. Its foundation was laid in 1912 and completed in 1914 by the design of the junior architect of the construction department of the Syrdarya region I.A. Markevich, engineers N.I. Botvinkin and R.P. Kochar.The project itself, its architectural and artistic part, will be implemented in a short period of time at a high artistic level. Several project drawings that have survived to our time are proof of that. I.A.Markevich sends the project to the headquarters of the Engineering Committee in St. Petersburg for approval. Originally, it was a rectangular structure with a semicircular altar hill (apse) in the east and a wide roof (entrance) in the east. The original design of the small church and gallery, which connected the small church and the church tower with the cathedral building, was not built, as the church tower was built later.The cathedral in Shymkent was designed in the second half of the XIX century - like other Orthodox monasteries of the early XX century, so the details of its appearance used the architecture of the ancient church of the XVII century and reworked by I.A.Markevich. Currently, the Regional State Puppet Theater is located in the cathedral building.

sozaq-qalashygy.name: Sozak Town
sozaq-qalashygy.fact: The center of Suzak district of South Kazakhstan region is located 70 km from Sholakkorgan, on the northern slope of…
sozaq-qalashygy.lead: The center of Suzak district of South Kazakhstan region is located 70 km from Sholakkorgan, on the northern slope of Karatau. Chronological period: X-XVIII centuries.
sozaq-qalashygy.bodyHtml:
The center of Suzak district of South Kazakhstan region is located 70 km from Sholakkorgan, on the northern slope of Karatau. Chronological period: X-XVIII centuries.The city was the first capital of the Kazakh Khanate. In 1465-1469, the horde of Kerey and Zhanibek was founded in this city. The name of the city of Suzak is first mentioned in written sources in connection with the visit of the Armenian king Getum to the great Mongol khan Monke in the middle of the XIII century.The maximum prosperity of the city was in the XV-XVII centuries. It corresponds to the period of prosperity of the Kazakh khanates. Suzak is important because it is located at the junction of the road from the steppes of Deshti Kipchak to Turkestan and Otrar, Sauran and Sairam, to the cities around the western Aral Sea, to the major centers of Shu and Talas. It became the main center of free exchange of peoples, connecting the steppe region with the south, which was engaged in agriculture.During the Dzungar invasion, Sozak became one of the largest fortresses. He provided food and weapons to the Kazakh army, which withstood the destructive attacks of the Dzungars. The fact that Sozak was a large city is even mentioned in Russian writings.The results of research conducted by the archeological expedition of the South Kazakhstan region revealed that the surviving part of the town consists of a citadel and a shahristan. The city's citadel was also located on a hill to the west of the hill. Traces of the surrounding walls indicate that the place was a gate. Rabads, where black people live, are left under modern housing.

ulken-qyluet.name: Great Kyluet
ulken-qyluet.fact: The Great Kyluet is a historical place associated with the life of Hodja Ahmed Yassavi, an underground place, the…
ulken-qyluet.lead: The Great Kyluet is a historical place associated with the life of Hodja Ahmed Yassavi, an underground place, the center of Sufism in the XII century. monument.
ulken-qyluet.bodyHtml:
The Great Kyluet is a historical place associated with the life of Hodja Ahmed Yassavi, an underground place, the center of Sufism in the XII century. monument.Hodja Ahmed Yassavi, who reached the age of prophethood (63 years old), went underground and spent the rest of his life in this "Kyluet". Kyluet is one of the semi-underground religious buildings, built in the XII century and operating continuously until the first half of the XX century.According to scholars, the word “kyluet” comes from the Arabic word "haluatun", which means isolation, isolation from the world, a place of worship in solitude. K.A. Yasawi made many disciples in this Kyluet and wrote his works like Diwani Hikmet.Located 150 m from the Yasawi mausoleum, the building is large, with a flat roof and two doors. The underground mosque has three doors. The total number of rooms is 18. Kyluet consists of rooms for religious ceremonies and household chores. The place of worship was built in several stages, the oldest part of which is the Gar (XII century), a small room with a depth of 4 m. The walls and dome are made of square bricks, woven with the ancient “melt” system. The walls have small cavities for candles. It is connected to the prayer hall by a narrow staircase. The last hall is a four-room house with a ventilated roof. Archaeological research shows that small and medium-sized halls were built in the second stage of construction (XV-XVII centuries), and other buildings in the XVIII-XIX centuries. built.

haqnazar-han-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Haknazar Khan
haqnazar-han-kesenesi.fact: Haknazar's mausoleum is located 6 km south of Suzak aul, Suzak district, South Kazakhstan region.
haqnazar-han-kesenesi.lead: Haknazar's mausoleum is located 6 km south of Suzak aul, Suzak district, South Kazakhstan region. The monument, which is up to 12 meters high, was erected in 2012.
haqnazar-han-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
Haknazar's mausoleum is located 6 km south of Suzak aul, Suzak district, South Kazakhstan region. The monument, which is up to 12 meters high, was erected in 2012.Haqnazar Khan is the fourth greatest khan of the Kazakh khans in 1538-1580. After the accession of Kassym Khan's son Haknazar Khan to the throne, he worked hard to strengthen and consolidate the power of the khanate government. He reunited the Kazakh Khanate, which was divided during the reigns of his predecessors Takhir Khan and Buidash Khan. He strengthened the Kazakh-Kyrgyz union, and even in the historical records of that time Haknazar Khan was called “the king of the Kazakhs and Kyrgyz”. He sought to establish allied relations with the Shaibani dynasty in Mawarannahr. With the mediation of the Kazakh Khanate, Moscow established ties with the Uzbek Khanates in Turkestan. In his relations with Russia, Haknazar Khan followed in the footsteps of his father Kasym.

shymkent-qalashygy.name: Shymkent Town
shymkent-qalashygy.fact: It is located in the southern part of Shymkent on a high place between the rivers Badam and Koshkar-Ata.Chronological…
shymkent-qalashygy.lead: It is located in the southern part of Shymkent on a high place between the rivers Badam and Koshkar-Ata.Chronological period: BC II-I centuries. The word Shymkent (Turkish shym - valley, cavern, village - Iranian settlement) means a green city.
shymkent-qalashygy.bodyHtml:
It is located in the southern part of Shymkent on a high place between the rivers Badam and Koshkar-Ata.Chronological period: BC II-I centuries. The word Shymkent (Turkish shym - valley, cavern, village - Iranian settlement) means a green city. Bronze arrows and daggers made by Saka tribes were found in Shymkent. Saka descendants - in I thousand years BC, Kangyuis were able to create a very powerful state Kangyu (Kanly).There were several settlements on the territory of Shymkent.Shymkent is first mentioned as a settlement in the book “Zafar Name” (“Book of Victory”) written by the Persian historian Sharaf ad-Din Ali Yazdi (1425) about the military campaigns of Timur in 1365-1366. Until now, most scholars have speculated that the settlements on the territory of modern Shymkent existed in the XI-XII centuries. During the archeological excavations by archeologist Baurzhan Baitanaev, a doctor of sciences from Shymkent, B.D. revaled pottery dating back to the II century BC. These artifacts are the reason for the assumption that Shymkent is 2200 years old. In addition, the historian-scientist, studying the writings of the Chinese monk Sima Qian, who traveled through Central Asia in 629, suggests that the medieval name of Shymkent may be Nezhiket (meaning “new city” in Arabic). This is confirmed by other historical data. For example, one of the most prosperous cities along the Great Silk Road at that time was called Nejiket, one of the gates of Ispidzhab (Sairam). Later it was called “Shymkent Gate”. After the Mongol era, Shymkent became a large city. Its remains are a well-preserved fortress of the old city in the center of the city. The shape of the castle is arc-shaped, 25 m above the ground. The size of the arch is 30-45 m, there are towers in the corners, the entrance gate is on the wall on the south side. Philip Nazarov, a translator from the Siberian branch, said: “... The fortress is built on a high hill along the Badam River (city) and is surrounded by a high wall. There is no other way but to enter the city on a narrow road that can only be crossed by a horse on the river. Water enters the city through windows carved into the walls and fills the canals dug in the city, some of which are equipped with water mills. The houses are made of baked bricks and have no windows. For some reason, the doors are open everywhere to let the light into the house, ” - he said.

ysmail-ata-saulet-kesheni.name: Ismailata Architectural Complex
ysmail-ata-saulet-kesheni.fact: Ismail Ata architectural complex of XI-XV centuries is located in Turbat aul of Kazygurt district of South Kazakhstan…
ysmail-ata-saulet-kesheni.lead: Ismail Ata architectural complex of XI-XV centuries is located in Turbat aul of Kazygurt district of South Kazakhstan region.
ysmail-ata-saulet-kesheni.bodyHtml:
Ismail Ata architectural complex of XI-XV centuries is located in Turbat aul of Kazygurt district of South Kazakhstan region.Ishmael Ata, who was born and raised there in the XIII century, continued the religious teachings of Hodja Ahmed Yassawi, guided the people to goodness, religion and faith, and later glorified the name of Ibrahim Ata's son Turbat. His descendants, who continued the teachings of the fathers, formed a special chain of religious teachings from father to son and became a very influential group. He was very active in the spread of Islam in the world, and for several centuries in Maurenahr and Turkestan, Khorasan and India, the mausoleum was first built in the XI century. In the XIV century, during the Timurid dynasty, the mausoleum was rebuilt and turned into an architectural complex. According to ancient sources, the mausoleum on the head of Ismail Ata was built by Amir Temir.Next to it is the mausoleum of Gabriel.The mausoleum of Ismail-ata is covered with two domes. It is located on the octagonal walls of the outer dome, and the outer dome is hexagonal at the bottom, and cylindrical at the bottom.Near the Ismail Ata architectural complex there is a mausoleum of his son Isaac Ata (X-XI). The architectural complex consists of several mausoleums, such as the mausoleum of Ismail Ata, the mausoleum of Gabriel Ata, the mausoleum of Koshkar Ata and a medieval mosque, a mausoleum of Sufi healers, a gate.

sypatai-batyr-kesenesi.name: Sypatay Batyr Mausoleum
sypatai-batyr-kesenesi.fact: Sipatai Alibekuli (1781-1868) is a member of the Dulat tribe of the Great Zhuz.
sypatai-batyr-kesenesi.lead: Sipatai Alibekuli (1781-1868) is a member of the Dulat tribe of the Great Zhuz. His father, Alibek, was a modest man, well-known in the region for sewing boots and weaving.
sypatai-batyr-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
Sipatai Alibekuli (1781-1868) is a member of the Dulat tribe of the Great Zhuz. His father, Alibek, was a modest man, well-known in the region for sewing boots and weaving. But both Andas and Sipatai grow up to be proud and high-minded.According to the old people, Kenen Azerbayev described the image of Sipatai Batyr: He was eloquent and resourceful.

”Sipatai Batyr did not give his land to the enemy, he did not rest day and night in winter and summer, he returned the cattle and buried the enemy. He did not bring any enemies from Karabalta to Turkestan, which fell to Dulat in 1806, he himself attacked and resisted the enemies of his country. Sipatai Batyr did not turn away from the fierce khans. He said to Kenesary, who showed his heart at the first meeting: There is a child, and the father can take revenge - beheading or wounds. “At that time, Sipatai batyr had three crossroads. One is the way to the Kokand Khanate, the other is the way to join the Kenesary movement against Russian colonialism, and the third is the way to submit to Russia and move forward. In 1847, Sipatai, along with a number of Semirechye sultans and bi, swore an oath of allegiance to Russia. The mausoleum is located to the east of Sypatai aul of Merke district.

nurpeiis-haziret-meshiti.fact: The mosque is located in Karabutak village of Kargaly district of Aktobe region.

Hazrat Nurpeis Baigarauly is a well-known cleric, public figure, a scholar. Along with religious literacy, he was fluent in Arabic and Persian.

Hazrat Nurpeis was born in Karatobe, Tomarotkel locality of Shyngyrlau district, located in current West Kazakhstan. This famous scientist lived in the period of 1817 - 1880. As a young man, he took lessons from a village mullah, and later went to the Kogiltash madrasah in Bukhara to study for 6 years. After that he studied in Sham in Arabia for 4 years, and returned home very literate. After arriving in the country, he went to St. Petersburg, where he was received by the tsar. Russian Tsar advised Nurpeis to go along the Ural, Elek, Or, and Kargaly rivers and build several mosques there in order to spread and propagate the Muslim religion.

Hazrat Nurpeis will have had a royal decree “All conditions should be created for the construction of a mosque”. Nurpeis, who settled in the village of Karabutak in Kargaly, began construction of a mosque. Due to negotiations with people the construction equipment was brought from Bashkortostan. The mosque is located on the other side of the river Karabutak. In 1905, Safa Ishan built a new mosque in the center of the village, as it was difficult for the villagers to go to the mosque at certain times of the year. Safa Ishan is the eldest son of Nurpeis hazrat.

temir-meshiti.name: Temir Mosque
temir-meshiti.fact: The mosque was built in 1905, in Temir with the financial support of Orenburg merchant Mazhit Batkululi.
temir-meshiti.lead: The mosque was built in 1905, in Temir with the financial support of Orenburg merchant Mazhit Batkululi. However, he was bothered by local biis, bolsheviks and activists.
temir-meshiti.bodyHtml:
The mosque was built in 1905, in Temir with the financial support of Orenburg merchant Mazhit Batkululi. However, he was bothered by local biis, bolsheviks and activists. In the end, Mazhit Batkululi is looking for an imam who will own a local mosque. Ahmed Halfe, a religiously literate preacher, owns a mosque. Akhmet graduated from the Kazan, Ufa madrasah and became a khalfa. Despite the difficulties of the times, the spread of religion among the people, the growth of its prestige was greatly influenced by this literate person, who became Akhmet khalfe among the people. In 1926, he was a delegate to the Congress of Muslims in Ufa. Akhmet khalfe is accused of propagating the religion among the people, along with Akhmet Baitursynov, a former chairman of the West Alashorda government's religious department, and Sagidulla Iztleuov, a friend of Mustafa Shokai. In 1937, he was sentenced to death by firing squad.The walls of the mosque are made of treated brown stone with clay. On the northern surface, the octagonal tower is covered with wood and tin, the top of the roof is a hexagonal rectangle with a half-cross. On this page there is a half-dome-shaped closed prayer chamber. The interior is divided into three service rooms, connected to the two-story prayer room in the center and the exit door.The Temir Mosque is a rectangular (10x22 m), two-storey building built in the early ХХ century. It is located in Temir town of Temir district of Aktobe region.

Reference: 1. Regional sacred sites of Kazakhstan. –Astana: Foliant, 2017. –128 p .; 2. Sacred Kazakhstan. Volume 2 –Astana: 2018. –113-p.

otan-ana-otan-qorgaushylarga-arnalgan-mo.name: "The Defenders of the Motherland" monument
otan-ana-otan-qorgaushylarga-arnalgan-mo.fact: The complex is located at the intersection of Manas and Hajimukan Munaitpasov streets.
otan-ana-otan-qorgaushylarga-arnalgan-mo.lead: The complex is located at the intersection of Manas and Hajimukan Munaitpasov streets. The official opening took place on May 9, 2001.
otan-ana-otan-qorgaushylarga-arnalgan-mo.bodyHtml:
The complex is located at the intersection of Manas and Hajimukan Munaitpasov streets. The official opening took place on May 9, 2001.

The authors are a group of Kazakhstan architects and sculptors: architects Aliakparov Makash Tynyshtykpaevich, Kuritsyn Alexander Fedorovich, Baimukashev Yuri Dyusengalievich, Taitaliev Baktybai Halykovich, Baimukashev Dyusen Yuryevich, Beksultanov Amangeldy Kuanyshbekovich, Kalmakhanov Aidarkhan Seitmahanovich, Novopoltsev Nikolay Alexandrovich.

Fountains on the front alley, courageous faces on the bas-reliefs, the figure of the mother in mournful silence and Eternal fire - the memory of the people's feat.

The monument "Otankorgaushylar" is one of the most beautiful in the country. The bronze stele, consisting of 101 spikes, symbolizes the unity of all ethnic groups living in Kazakhstan. The stela is placed on a square, raised powerful granite base with green slopes along three sides and a wide staircase leading to it. The central figure of the monument is a woman. For the first time in such a memorial complex, a woman is depicted, not grieving, but smiling, calling for unity and harmony. The bas-relief on the right depicts Soviet soldiers of the Great Patriotic War.

On the bas-relief on the left are the Kazakh batyrs, who won the hard struggle of the Dzungarian Khanate in the 18th century. The eternal flame is lit at the foot of the monument. The bowl, symbolizing prosperity and peace on earth, held in the hands of the Motherland, is covered with a thin layer of gold leaf.

The memorial in 24 meters contained 63 tons of pure Karaganda bronze. And it was created by his creative team of Karaganda sculptors. The hand to it was put by metallurgists, sculptors, fitters, workers of other specialties - thousands of people. The main avenue that leads to the Monument to the defenders of the Moherland is the main composition axis that pervades the whole territory of the park and unites all the functional zones into one whole.

There are parades of Victory Day and lovers walking, slowly walking mothers with wheeling prams with baby from nearby houses and drawing teenagers on roller skates and skateboards. Dancing fountains in colorful light decoration, comfortable benches, green lawns, variegated flower beds and sails on the Rowing Channel - the monument to the Defenders of the Motherland has long and firmly won the hearts of the townspeople.
