botai-qonysy.bodyHtml:
It is located 1.5 km from the aul of Nikolsk, Aiyrtau district, North Kazakhstan region. Chronological period: Eneolithic (late IV - III millennia BC).Archaeologist V.F. Seibert, who has been studying the settlement since 1980 (more than 30 years), identified the Botai culture on the basis of the study of similar monuments in northern Kazakhstan.The significance of the monument is that the wild horse was tamed for the first time on earth. In the Eneolithic period, the economic and cultural pattern formed in the steppe areas of Uralsk-Kazakhstan can be defined as a predominant, diversified horse breeding, which developed the economy. Hunting, fishing and household trades still played an important role in providing for the population.The leading place in the economy was taken by tools related to woodworking and house building. The houses in the settlement were built in a unique architectural way. In general, the settlements of the Botai culture are similar to the “shoshala” type of construction, built half on the ground.Bone-carving played a special role in the household of the Botai people. The ancient inhabitants used bone products in various industrial activities and in everyday life. In the Eneolithic, all the basic methods of bone and horn processing were known. Embellished horse saddles, stone irons, and kalsaps gave a religious and religious character, they must have been used for some ritual purpose, not for household chores. Botai is included in the UNESCO list.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –94-96 pp.

beibitshilik-zhane-kelisim-saraiy.name: Palace of Peace and Reconciliation
beibitshilik-zhane-kelisim-saraiy.fact: The Palace of Peace and Reconciliation is located on Tauelsizdik Avenue. It was opened in late 2006.
beibitshilik-zhane-kelisim-saraiy.lead: The Palace of Peace and Reconciliation is located on Tauelsizdik Avenue. It was opened in late 2006. The author of the project is the world-famous British architect Norman Foster, who created many amazing structures around the world.
beibitshilik-zhane-kelisim-saraiy.bodyHtml:
The Palace of Peace and Reconciliation is located on Tauelsizdik Avenue.

It was opened in late 2006. The author of the project is the world-famous British architect Norman Foster, who created many amazing structures around the world.

The Palace of Peace and Reconciliation is a Kazakhstan’s truly unique structure, whose blazing faces, in the best way possible, decorate the capital. The idea of its construction belongs to the First President of the Republic Nursultan Nazarbayev, who proposed to create the building especially for the Congresses of leaders of World and Traditional Religions.

The Palace of Peace and Reconciliation combines grandeur and elegance. This is the only building in the world in the shape of a pyramid is considered another wonder of the world. The uniqueness of the building is its shape, is also called the Pyramid. The top of the pyramid is decorated with a stained glass window with images of 130 pigeons - a symbol of the people of Kazakhstan, and their number is equal to the number of ethnic groups living in Kazakhstan. The building was built according to the principles of the “Golden Section search” - the height of the object is equal to the sides of the square lying at the base. The lifts do not move upwards, but under a slope of 60 degrees. Such elevators, in addition to the Palace of Peace and Reconciliation, are found in the Eiffel Tower in Paris, in the Luxor Hotel in Las Vegas, etc.

The main halls of the Palace of Peace and Reconciliation: on the 1st floor is the exhibition area, as well as the Pyramid’s pride is the Opera Hall, on the 3rd floor in the largest hall of the Atrium is the Peace and Reconciliation Museum and on the 8th floor is the top of the pyramid Cradle, where is the small conference hall with the beautiful view of our young capital.

The largest conference hall is called “Cheops Atrium”Its total area exceeds 2,000 sq. m.The hall delights with its whiteness and nobleness of marble. Around the hall there are windows from which soft daylight streams. The hall is equipped with modern lighting technology, which allows both daylight and artificial lighting for special occasions. The Congress of Leaders of World and Traditional Religions are held in this hall. The Central part of the hall atrium is the center of the whole building, it accumulates all the positive energy, so you can get up, raise your hands and make a wish.

The exposition of the Atrium hall reveals the whole range of activities of the Congress of Leaders of World and Traditional Religion, where a rich and informative conversation on the spiritual and cultural rapprochement of communities and nations took place, joint declarations and addresses of spiritual leaders were addressed to citizens.

The goals and objectives of the Congress of Leaders of World and Traditional Religions are to promote global dialogue between religions and cultures, to deepen and strengthen mutual understanding and respect between religious communities, to develop a culture of tolerance and mutual respect.

Temporary creative exhibitions of Kazakhstan and foreign artists are held in the exhibition halls.

On the top floor of the Pyramid is located the “Cradle” hall, symbolizing human hands, united by a desire for peace and harmony, light and prosperity in the world. This is the main idea of the creation of the Pyramid - the preservation of peace and harmony in every heart, in relations between people, nations and states. In order to climb into this hall, guests climb the stairs, which are surrounded on both sides by the Winter Garden, which has no common intersection point, which will lead guests to the top of the Pyramid. Going up the stairs, you see different plants – living and artificial – that has arrived to us from different corners of the globe, creating a special energy and harmony around us.

The Center of Contemporary Art "Kulanshy" is located here on the sixth floor of the Pyramid. Translated from the Kazakh "Kulanshy" means "a man with kulan" (wild steppe horse).

Exhibitions and recitals of Kazakh, Chinese, Brazilian, French, Spanish and many other are regularly exhibited here.

The center is open on weekdays from 10:00 to 18:00, on Saturday from 11:00 to 15:00, Sunday is a day off.

The palace works seven days a week.
Excursions are conducted in three languages - Kazakh, Russian and English.

qarasai-zhane-agyntai-batyrlar-keseneler.name: Mausoleum of Karasay and Agyntay Heroes
qarasai-zhane-agyntai-batyrlar-keseneler.fact: The mausoleums of the heroes are located on Kulshynbay hill near the aul of Madeniet, Aiyrtau district, North…
qarasai-zhane-agyntai-batyrlar-keseneler.lead: The mausoleums of the heroes are located on Kulshynbay hill near the aul of Madeniet, Aiyrtau district, North Kazakhstan region.The mausoleum was built in the XVII century on the burial place of heroes Karasai Altynayevich (1589-1671) and Agyntai (about 1599-1672), who fought against the Dzungar invaders for the…
qarasai-zhane-agyntai-batyrlar-keseneler.bodyHtml:
The mausoleums of the heroes are located on Kulshynbay hill near the aul of Madeniet, Aiyrtau district, North Kazakhstan region.The mausoleum was built in the XVII century on the burial place of heroes Karasai Altynayevich (1589-1671) and Agyntai (about 1599-1672), who fought against the Dzungar invaders for the independence of the Kazakh Khanate. Next to him are a pair of spears. There is a cemetery around the mausoleums.Karasai and Agyntai are heroes, famous commanders, outstanding historical figures. It was a time when the Kazakh-Dzungar war was in full swing, and the tactics and strategy of the two nomadic countries were gradually being challenged. At that time, it was two centuries since the Kazakh people became an independent state, established a single ethnic consciousness. Tegeuri repeatedly fought with strong Kalmyk heroes and won. Their status has grown by demonstrating new tactics of countering the enemy, new ways to defend the country.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –304-307-pp.

mangilik-el-saltanatty-arkasy.name: "Mangilik Yel" Triumphal arch
mangilik-el-saltanatty-arkasy.fact: One of the brightest and most symbolic decorations of Nur-Sultan is the Arc de Triumph.
mangilik-el-saltanatty-arkasy.lead: One of the brightest and most symbolic decorations of Nur-Sultan is the Arc de Triumph. It is located at the intersection of Mangilik El avenue and 25th street.
mangilik-el-saltanatty-arkasy.bodyHtml:
One of the brightest and most symbolic decorations of Nur-Sultan is the Arc de Triumph. It is located at the intersection of Mangilik El avenue and 25th street.

This iconic architectural structure was erected in 2012 on the initiative of the Head of State Nursultan Nazarbayev on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of Kazakhstan's Independence and symbolizes the success of the young republic in the first 20 years of its formation and development. To the left of the arch span is the sculpture of Aksakal - a symbol of wisdom, a carrier of spirituality and thought of the people. Through its image projected such majestic inherent in the Kazakh nation categories as: "Danalyk" "Danyshpan","Gulam".To the right of the arched passage in the niche is the relief sculpture of the Mother Woman, the guardian of the hearth. In the image of Ana, sacred for the Kazakhs, such unshakable values as "Otan Ana" - Motherland-Mother, "Zher Ana" - Native land, "Ana tili" - Mother tongue are intertwined. Under each of the figures is the famous Kazakh solar sign - "Eternity". In the Turkic peoples, the image of the solar sign served as a guard against all the evil and was a source of light, heat, life and good. Here it has one more meaning - the state is eternal, as are the eternal themes of sculptural compositions. At the top of each of the sculptures is the coat of arms of the Republic of Kazakhstan. The emblem gives majesty to the structure, demonstrates exceptional state significance and reveals the fullness of the state symbols. The style of the archway line emphasizes the specific national specifics of the structure: it is not purely eastern, but not absolutely European.On top of the front there is an inscription "Mangilik El". "Mangilik El" has deep historical roots and great semantic value. In the Turkic annals, the word "mangi" (eternal) was often used in parallel with "Tengri", "Kudai", "Allah". In this sense, "Mangilik El" means "Country, the people of the Most High" and is a kind of timeless amulet of the state and nation. At the top of the entire facade composition is a complex ornamental element, which is used in the national flag. And crowns the entire composition of the symbols of the national flag in the form of the sun and the hovering golden eagle. The sun is the source of life and energy. In the language of symbolism, the silhouette of an eagle means state power, breadth and perspicacity. In the world view of the nation, the golden eagle is a symbol of freedom, independence, striving for the goal, for height, for the future. Four corners of the arch are flanked by columns, which emphasizes its classical style. In the niche on the left side is the figure of the Warrior-nomad, and on the right side - the serviceman of the modern Kazakhstani army. The idea of this sculptural group is that the protection of the state is one of the main and sacred values of the Kazakh nation. The figure of a modern young soldier personifies the reliable protection of modern Kazakhstan striving for the future. The side parts also have peculiar niches, where the symbolic figures "Tai-kazan" are located. For the Turkic peoples, "Tai-kazan" has a profound meaning, which reflects unity, hospitality and prosperity. Also, the side walls are decorated with elaborate Kazakh ornaments, where the shield of Kazakh soldiers "Kalkan" is located in the center of the upper part. The shield at all times symbolized protection from threats, reliability, fortitude, victory. "Kalkan" forms a stable associative series - "Batyrlyk", "Erlik". Inside, the arched opening on both sides is decorated with relief panels measuring 5.2 x 3.5 meters each. The plot line of one of them reflects the development of the history of the Kazakh nation in the symbolized periodization of "Saki" - "Türks" - "Kipchaki" - "Kazakhs". The main theme is the "Uly Kesh", reflecting the basic philosophy of the nomadic civilization and signifying the progress and development. On the other hand, the theme of the panel is devoted to the main value of the nation - Independence.

Inside the arch, while climbing, along the stairs, there are landscape, reportage and genre photographs telling the visitors the history of the capital: Bozok - Akmolinsk - Tselinograd - Akmola - Astana - Nur-Sultan. In the upper part of the arch there is a hall of periodic exhibitions and a multimedia exhibition. After getting acquainted with the multimedia exposition and the exposition of the exhibition hall, having overcome 30 steps, it is possible to climb to the observation deck, from which you can see the Avenue Mangilik El and its surroundings. The height of the architectural design allows you to be on the dominant position and retain visibility along the entire length of Mangilik El avenue. In front of visitors, as in the palm of your hand, you can see the panorama of the square itself.

abylai-han-rezidentsiiasy-kesheni.name: Abylai Khan Residence Complex
abylai-han-rezidentsiiasy-kesheni.fact: Abylai Khan's residence is located in Petropavlovsk, the center of the North Kazakhstan region.
abylai-han-rezidentsiiasy-kesheni.lead: Abylai Khan's residence is located in Petropavlovsk, the center of the North Kazakhstan region. There is a lot of controversy about the fact that the complex "Residence of Ablai Khan" is called the house of Ablai.
abylai-han-rezidentsiiasy-kesheni.bodyHtml:
Abylai Khan's residence is located in Petropavlovsk, the center of the North Kazakhstan region. There is a lot of controversy about the fact that the complex "Residence of Ablai Khan" is called the house of Ablai.

The house, built in 1765, was not a “khan's residence”, as at that time Ablai had only the title of sultan. At the request of Abylai Khan and with the permission of the tsarist government, a house was actually built near the river Ishim. The house is made of wood. It covers many state and political issues. According to legend, this house caught fire, and then in 1829 this two-story stone house was built instead.

The residence of Abylai Khan, opened in 2008, has exhibits and a diorama depicting the khan of the Kazakh Horde of the XVIII century, a prominent statesman, commander, diplomat. Prior to the exposition, the residence was called “White House”, “House of Abylai Khan”, “Military Infirmary”.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –341-343-pp.

bozoq-qalashygy.name: Bozok Town
bozoq-qalashygy.fact: Town Bozok that existed in the 8th–18th centuries, consists of several periods.
bozoq-qalashygy.lead: Town Bozok that existed in the 8th–18th centuries, consists of several periods.
bozoq-qalashygy.bodyHtml:
Town Bozok that existed in the 8th–18th centuries, consists of several periods. The ancient settlement Bozok is located in the center of Saryarka, on streamflow separation of the North-Siberian basin (Esil, Sileti, Shiderty) and in the Middle Asia (Nura, Sarysu) lakes, on the east side of the Buzuk river located on the left bank of Esyl river.

The Bozok settlement is very important for the capital of Kazakhstan as an ancient source. Thousands years ago emergence of military units in the area where modern Astana is situated is connected with geostrategic factor, which could be used for management of steppe caravans of the Silk way. This is a unique place considering its possession of lands, strategic polygon and trade ways.

The head of state N.A. Nazarbayev wrote in his works that “Medieval town Bozok can be considered as the ancestor of Akmola, and the capital of modern Kazakhstan and Astana is its last successor”.

Town Bozok consists of three groups that are situated from the North to the South (central, northern and southern). The central part of the city consists of triangular trenches. Each of them is surrounded by a fence, and at the junction of three quarters is an area of rectangular shape.

The town was administrative and trade center of the X-XІ centuries and military base of Kipchak regents along the Great silk way. In the XІІІ-XV centuries, the settlement deemed to be sacred, holy and became the place of burial of aristocracy representatives. Since the ХІV century Bozok town had been the Islamic spiritual elite center of Nur-Yessil region.

Moreover the Bozok became increasingly important in the spiritual life of people. It is considered a holy place among Muslims, where it is worshiped, commemorated the spirits, food shared, national games played, and competitions holded. At the same time, the word Turk means "steppe", white steppe and white-haired settlement.

The Bozok was one of the important centers of the famous Silk Way that linked west and east in ancient times, and Nur-Sultan became the golden bridge for current western and eastern civilization.

Reference: The Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –101-104 pp.

syrymbet-mekeni.name: Settlement Syrymbet
syrymbet-mekeni.fact: The place of birth of Chokan Valikhanov, which dates back to the 1920s, is the settlement of Syrymbet, the wife of the…
syrymbet-mekeni.lead: The place of birth of Chokan Valikhanov, which dates back to the 1920s, is the settlement of Syrymbet, the wife of the Middle Zhuz khan Uali Abylaikhan, the settlement of Chokan Valikhanov's grandmother. It is located in Syrymbet aul of Aiyrtau district of North Kazakhstan region.Ms.
syrymbet-mekeni.bodyHtml:
The place of birth of Chokan Valikhanov, which dates back to the 1920s, is the settlement of Syrymbet, the wife of the Middle Zhuz khan Uali Abylaikhan, the settlement of Chokan Valikhanov's grandmother. It is located in Syrymbet aul of Aiyrtau district of North Kazakhstan region.Ms. Aiganym's settlement consists of a pine house, a mosque, a madrasah, a bathhouse, a stable, and a windmill. Aiganym is the youngest wife of Uali, the first son of Abylai Khan. In his time, Tsar Alexander I issued an order to build a complex for the winter in the Syrymbet. Historical documents show that this complex was built from 1824 to 1834. A.K. Gaines described the residence of Princess Aiganym in Syrymbet. It was restored in 1985 and the Chokan Valikhanov Republican Historical and Ethnographic Museum was opened. At that time, the legendary Valikhanovs' settlement on the slopes of Syrymbet was restored. Basically, Chokan's paintings about his ancestral homeland were used as a guide. Thus, the settlement, created for the benefit of the country, is located on the slopes of the mysterious Syrymbet with its unique appearance. Today, the historical and ethnographic museum of Chokan and the settlement of Aiganym are combined to form a museum complex in Syrymbet.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –392-394-pp.

respublika-alany-tauelsizdik-monumenti.name: The Republic Square - the Monument of Independence
respublika-alany-tauelsizdik-monumenti.fact: The Republic Square is a venue for festive parades of the Almaty community of workers and for military parades.
respublika-alany-tauelsizdik-monumenti.lead: The Republic Square is a venue for festive parades of the Almaty community of workers and for military parades. It was opened in 1980s. The Independence Monument (1996) was installed on the Republic Square. The Independence Monument was opened on December 16, 1996. The monument is located on Republic Square in Almaty.
respublika-alany-tauelsizdik-monumenti.bodyHtml:
The Republic Square is a venue for festive parades of the Almaty community of workers and for military parades. It was opened in 1980s.

The Independence Monument (1996) was installed on the Republic Square. The Independence Monument was opened on December 16, 1996. The monument is located on Republic Square in Almaty.

In the center of the Independence Monument, which is rooted in Kazakh applied art, the composition is made up of cubic pillars covered with national ornament and reaches 28 meters in height.

The head of the central pillar, tucked into the blue sky, is a tulip-shaped, with the coat of arms of Kazakhstan engraved on it. On top of it is a bronze snow leopard, an eagle bird is in his right hand, a bow is in his left hand, a dagger is in his belt and a chain mail on a shoulder, and a strong armor of a young warrior with gold-plated arrows (6 m high and 4 t in weight) with formidability, it clearly reflects the strength and scale of the Independence Monument.

Reference: The Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. – 465-466 pp.

tauelsizdik-tany-1986-zhylgy-zheltoqsan-.name: “Morning of Independence” - Memorial for the Event December, 1986.
tauelsizdik-tany-1986-zhylgy-zheltoqsan-.fact: Monument “Morning of Independence” was opened in 2006, in honor of the 20th anniversary of the December event.
tauelsizdik-tany-1986-zhylgy-zheltoqsan-.lead: Monument “Morning of Independence” was opened in 2006, in honor of the 20th anniversary of the December event. The monument is located at the junction of Zheltoksan and Satpayev streets in Almaty. The monument consists of 3 parts.
tauelsizdik-tany-1986-zhylgy-zheltoqsan-.bodyHtml:
Monument “Morning of Independence” was opened in 2006, in honor of the 20th anniversary of the December event. The monument is located at the junction of Zheltoksan and Satpayev streets in Almaty.

The monument consists of 3 parts. The splited-center double columns describe past and future conflicts, signifying that the state has gained freedom and independence. The image of a handkerchief wrapped around his right hand and a symbolic bird striving forward, symbolizes the nation's call for unity and solidarity. The monument is dedicated to the Kazakh youth, who died for independence, future of nation, destiny of generations.

In December 1986, the Kazakh youth took to the streets in protest of the colonial, governor-administrative system of the Soviet government. Young people wanted justice, equality and independence. This event is a significant event in the history of the Kazakh people striving for freedom and independence.

Reference: The Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. – 467-468 pp.

voznesensk-kafedraly-shirkeui.name: Voznesensk Procathedral
voznesensk-kafedraly-shirkeui.fact: It is located in the 28th Panfilov Guards Park dedicated to the heroes of the Second World War in Almaty.
voznesensk-kafedraly-shirkeui.lead: It is located in the 28th Panfilov Guards Park dedicated to the heroes of the Second World War in Almaty. Voznesensk Procathedral is a unique type of engineering construction, height - 56 m.
voznesensk-kafedraly-shirkeui.bodyHtml:
It is located in the 28th Panfilov Guards Park dedicated to the heroes of the Second World War in Almaty.

Voznesensk Procathedral is a unique type of engineering construction, height - 56 m. Its construction began on September 26, 1903 in Almaty on the initiative of the Honorary Bishop of Turkestan and Tashkent Paisi (Vinogradov). In 1906, it received the first visitors. The building is made of blue spruce of the Tien Shan. It is designed by the project of Zenkov (one of the first architects of Verny). The walls of the church are decorated by local artist Nikolai Khludov. Construction materials were delivered from all over the empire: cement was from Tashkent, ceramic tiles were from the Kos and Dorr plant, paper artifacts were from Kovalevsky factory in St. Petersburg, nickel-plated metal products were made in the famous V. Zemtsov plant in Tula, the paints were from Moscow, and the icons were from brought from A. Murashko's art workshop in Kiev. Due to the talent of architects, the church became a model of earthquake-resistant construction. It does not succumb to the temptations of time and nature. A 10-magnitude earthquake in 1911 did not harm the church. The church has passed from hand to hand many times in its history.

Reference: The Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. . –290-292-pp.

aqkol-zhaiylma-qalashygy.name: Akkol-Zhayilma Town
aqkol-zhaiylma-qalashygy.fact: It is located in Ekibastuz district of Pavlodar region. Chronological period: about XIV-XIX centuries.
aqkol-zhaiylma-qalashygy.lead: It is located in Ekibastuz district of Pavlodar region. Chronological period: about XIV-XIX centuries. Akkol is also called Auliekol by local Kazakh elders, and little is known about the region from medieval genealogies and historical records.
aqkol-zhaiylma-qalashygy.bodyHtml:
It is located in Ekibastuz district of Pavlodar region. Chronological period: about XIV-XIX centuries.

Akkol is also called Auliekol by local Kazakh elders, and little is known about the region from medieval genealogies and historical records. Looking at them, we see that the place of Akkol-Zhailma in Kazakh history is no less than the historical centers such as Bayanaul, Karkaraly, Ulytau. Akkol-Zhailma region occupies a vast area in the lower reaches of the rivers Olenty and Shiderty. Akkol-Zhailma is distinguished by the beauty and natural resources of nature, it is considered to be the burial place of saints. This region is special for Kazakhs who are engaged in nomadic animal husbandry. The shores of Akkol and Zhaman lakes, covered with thick reeds, are ideal for winter settlements.

In the Kazakh era, khan elections were held in Akkol-Zhailma. One of them was the election of Barakuly Bokei as the khan of the Middle Zhuz here on May 30, 1817. In order to discredit the Ablai dynasty, Russian military leaders also attended the gathering and directly influenced the gathering of other Kazakh sultans in Akkol-Zhailma. Legends, myths and legends about the Akkol-Zhailma region can be found in the collections of Mashkhur-Zhussup.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –140 p.

isabek-haziret-kesenesi.name: The Mausoleum of Isabek Hazret
isabek-haziret-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum is located in Akkol aul of Ekibastuz district of Pavlodar region.
isabek-haziret-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum is located in Akkol aul of Ekibastuz district of Pavlodar region. The mausoleum was built in 2010.Hazrat Isabek Ishan (1792-1871) was a preacher of Islam, a religious figure, a famous philosopher, educator and teacher of Mashkhur-Zhusip Kopeyev.
isabek-haziret-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum is located in Akkol aul of Ekibastuz district of Pavlodar region. The mausoleum was built in 2010.Hazrat Isabek Ishan (1792-1871) was a preacher of Islam, a religious figure, a famous philosopher, educator and teacher of Mashkhur-Zhusip Kopeyev. Known as Isabek Ishan, Isabek Muratkozhauli was engaged in religious education and was the only religious high official in the region. He opened a madrasah and a mosque in Akkol-Zhailma. Isabek Ishan was educated in this ancient city in the middle of the XVIII century. Under his influence, dozens of people from Bayanaul went on pilgrimage to Mecca. Isabek Ishan, as Hazrat, was a person of special value to the people, which is a national legend. He gained great prestige among the Kazakhs who lived from Ereymentau to the Omsk fortress. When the teacher of Mashkhur-Zhusip Kopeyuli Isabek Ishan passed away, he wrote a long mourning song: “We will never meet the person like religious Haziret Ishan Isabek!”.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –275-276-pp.

mashhur-zhusip-kopeiuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Mashkhur-Jusip Kopeyuli
mashhur-zhusip-kopeiuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum is located in Eskeldy village of Bayanaul district of Pavlodar region.Mashkhur-Zhusip Kopeyuli…
mashhur-zhusip-kopeiuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum is located in Eskeldy village of Bayanaul district of Pavlodar region.Mashkhur-Zhusip Kopeyuli (1858-1931) - a great thinker, folklorist, ethnographer, historian, philosopher, a famous figure of Kazakh culture and literature.
mashhur-zhusip-kopeiuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum is located in Eskeldy village of Bayanaul district of Pavlodar region.Mashkhur-Zhusip Kopeyuli (1858-1931) - a great thinker, folklorist, ethnographer, historian, philosopher, a famous figure of Kazakh culture and literature. Mashkhur-Zhussup is not only fluent in Arabic and Persian, but also a multi-lingual scholar.From the age of seven he began to collect samples of folk literature. From the age of fifteen he began to pursue a career in poetry. When Musa Shormanuli visited the village, he was impressed by the art of the little boy. The poet said to the boy's father: “Sufi, put an owl on your child's hat from now on. Let there be no foreign language! This is a boy who will be famous in his time!”- he said. Then the name “Mashkhur” was added to the name “Joseph”. According to eyewitnesses, the poet had clairvoyant and priestly qualities.Inside the mausoleum there are two rooms in the canonical Muslim style: a gurkhana and a cemetery. The doors to this room are lined with verses from the Koran. Even the entrance to the gold-plated mazar is a work of art (the author is the famous Kazakh jeweler Krym Altynbekov, who reconstructed the Golden Man). It is decorated with the strongest and most artistic paintings. The two domes of the mausoleum are covered with gold, and 99 names of God is inscribed on it.

Reference: Kazakhstan sacred objects
of whole national importance. – Astana: Foliant, 2017. –279-280-pp.

boraldai-saq-qorgandary.name: Boralday Sak Barrow
boraldai-saq-qorgandary.fact: It is located in the north-western part of Almaty on the left bank of the Big Almaty River.
boraldai-saq-qorgandary.lead: It is located in the north-western part of Almaty on the left bank of the Big Almaty River. Chronological date: 8th-3d centuries B.C and 3d century BC.
boraldai-saq-qorgandary.bodyHtml:
It is located in the north-western part of Almaty on the left bank of the Big Almaty River. Chronological date: 8th-3d centuries B.C and 3d century BC.

Covering an area of ​​430 hectares, the area of ​​the archeological park “Boroldai Sak barrow” consists of 47 large Sak and more than 200 Uisun barrows of Early Iron Age. It is a unique monument of the Early Iron Age, not only in Kazakhstan, but also in the CIS, on the scale of the Asian continent. Archaeologists call these mounds, which make up the main part of the cemetery, from 10 to 14 meters in height, “the burial complex of the royal family”. This is the burial place of Sak and Uisun tribesmen and commanders. Boralday barrows, one of the largest objects of Kazakh history, are the only line of burial mounds in the country, which unites the burials of Saks and Uisuns. The cemetery in the middle of the mound may be a Sak temple. According to scientists, there are rituals associated with the calendar.

zhasybai-omirulynyn-zherlengen-zheri.name: Burial Place of Zhasybai Omiruly
zhasybai-omirulynyn-zherlengen-zheri.fact: Zhasybai Batyr was buried on the shores of Lake Zhasybai, Bayanaul district, Pavlodar region.
zhasybai-omirulynyn-zherlengen-zheri.lead: Zhasybai Batyr was buried on the shores of Lake Zhasybai, Bayanaul district, Pavlodar region. Zhasybai batyr Omirovich (ca. 1716-1741) is a famous Kazakh hero who fought against the Dzungar invaders.
zhasybai-omirulynyn-zherlengen-zheri.bodyHtml:
Zhasybai Batyr was buried on the shores of Lake Zhasybai, Bayanaul district, Pavlodar region. Zhasybai batyr Omirovich (ca. 1716-1741) is a famous Kazakh hero who fought against the Dzungar invaders. A sniper with a sniper rifle. His father, Omir, was a fiery, eloquent speaker, and his mother was the sister of the famous Kazakh hero Olzhabay.

There is a lot of information about the hero in the writings of the Russian scientist N. Konshin, in folk chronicles, legends, in the poem “Er Zhasybai” dedicated to the hero himself. According to them, he was not only Olzhabai's nephew, but also a close friend and companion of the enemy. Well-known scientist Alkei Margulan says: “In the battle of Bayanaul in 1741, Olzhabai and Zhasybai's troops defeated the Dzungars. After Zhasybai was shot, one of the mountains where Olzhabai destroyed the Kalmyks was called “Kalmakkyrgan”.

qozy-korpesh-pen-baian-sulu-mazary.name: The Mausoleum of Kozy Korpesh and Bayan Sulu

qozy-korpesh-pen-baian-sulu-mazary.lead: It is located in Ayagoz district of East Kazakhstan region, about 10 km from Tansyk railway station, on the river Ayagoz. The tomb of Kozy Korpesh-Bayan Sulu, which belongs to the ancient Turkic era, is a necropolis of love dedicated to the tragic love of two lovers.
qozy-korpesh-pen-baian-sulu-mazary.bodyHtml:
It is located in Ayagoz district of East Kazakhstan region, about 10 km from Tansyk railway station, on the river Ayagoz. The tomb of Kozy Korpesh-Bayan Sulu, which belongs to the ancient Turkic era, is a necropolis of love dedicated to the tragic love of two lovers. It is one of the few “trunks” in Kazakhstan. This song, which is considered to be the oldest in the Kazakh lyric epic, can be considered as an official world that describes the social relations, livelihood, economic basis of nomadic nature of the tribes inhabiting the great steppes before Islam. Variety increases the realism of this song.The monument resembles an arrow of a giant bow, which is tens of kilometers long and ready to shoot. The symbol of some Kazakh tribes is an arrow. The bow-shaped bow occupies about twenty square kilometers. When our ancestors built the necropolis, they came up with a game that it alluded to. It is always known that the arrow hits the enemy. The building material of the mausoleum is flat stones laid in accordance with the pyramidal pattern. On one of the four sides there is a depression due to the lack of symmetry. The mausoleum and Bayan necropolis is a kind of arrow in the Egyptian pyramids.

aqbauyr-tarihi-arheologiialyq-kesheni.name: Akbauyr Historical and Archaeological Complex
aqbauyr-tarihi-arheologiialyq-kesheni.fact: It is located 3 km north of Besterek aul, Ulan district, East Kazakhstan region, at the hillside of Akbauyr mountain.
aqbauyr-tarihi-arheologiialyq-kesheni.lead: It is located 3 km north of Besterek aul, Ulan district, East Kazakhstan region, at the hillside of Akbauyr mountain. The territory of the historical and archeological complex “Akbauyr” contains petroglyphs of different epochs, burials of the Bronze Age, burial mounds of the Early Iron Age, including rare "mustache" burial mounds, burials dating back to the early Middle Ages.
aqbauyr-tarihi-arheologiialyq-kesheni.bodyHtml:
It is located 3 km north of Besterek aul, Ulan district, East Kazakhstan region, at the hillside of Akbauyr mountain. The territory of the historical and archeological complex “Akbauyr” contains petroglyphs of different epochs, burials of the Bronze Age, burial mounds of the Early Iron Age, including rare "mustache" burial mounds, burials dating back to the early Middle Ages. The reddish-purple ocher paintings on the walls of the cave date back to BC. It belongs to the beginning of V-III millennium. There were complex rituals and funeral rites related to the seasonal-calendar cycle, as well as astronomical observations of the Sun, Moon and stars, marking the equinox and solar eclipse.Researchers confirm the conclusions of scientists that a systematic astronomical observation was made here, and the graphic petroglyphs of the Neolithic period indicate the appearance of pictographic letters (pictogram - an ancient form of writing marked by conventional drawings). Ore ingots were found here, replicating the shape of stone wells, the remains of large and small blast furnaces in the gorge.According to some researchers, the Akbauyr complex is an energy and information generator. It is convenient to visit this unique place on March 22 and September 22. It is the time of spring and autumn equinoxes. There are only two such complexes in the world with inscriptions in a stone cave, like the territory of a rock yurt. Surprisingly, the roof of the cave has a large hole where the light shines during the day and the stars are visible at night.

It is located in the Chilikty valley on the territory of Zaisan district of East Kazakhstan region. The history of the monuments in Chilik dates back to BC. VIII-VІІ centuries. dates back to the Saka period. Later mounds were built in BC. II-I centuries. house, etc. VI-VII centuries. Turkic monuments.The monuments were first examined in 1909-191 by hydraulic engineer G.N. Boki, who in 1949-1962. Professor S.S. Chernikov studied and found 524 gold objects in Ш5 burial mounds in Chilikty burials.Since 2003, together with scientists of the Kazakh National University, archaeologists A. Tuleubayev and researchers of the Institute of Archeology named after A.Kh. Margulan have been conducting research. Among the burial mounds excavated in Chilikty necropolis, Baigetobe settlement is distinguished by its large size and very complex architectural construction. The large size of the plague (height 4 diam. 22 meters) proves that the person buried in it has a very high status in society. The size of the cemetery is 33.6 square meters. In the eastern part of the cemetery there is a dromed corridor. Scholars believe that the king who ruled the country was buried there. Despite the fact that the plague was looted, very valuable things were found there. The longest number of jewelry of the “Golden Man” is more than 4 and a half thousand. The number of large gold coins is 360.The uniqueness of the monument: Chilik's gold ornaments are the first in Saka art. They are designed to be worn while a person is alive. The Saka ruler wore clothes decorated with gold clasps during important holidays. This festive costume was restored by scientists.

aqtas-tauyndagy-qonyr-aulie-ungiri.name: Saint Konir Cave in Aktas Mountain
aqtas-tauyndagy-qonyr-aulie-ungiri.fact: The Saint Cave is located in Genghis Khan, 220 km south of Semey, between the aul of Sarzhal and the village of Karaul…
aqtas-tauyndagy-qonyr-aulie-ungiri.lead: The Saint Cave is located in Genghis Khan, 220 km south of Semey, between the aul of Sarzhal and the village of Karaul in the Abay district of East Kazakhstan region
aqtas-tauyndagy-qonyr-aulie-ungiri.bodyHtml:
The Saint Cave is located in Genghis Khan, 220 km south of Semey, between the aul of Sarzhal and the village of Karaul in the Abay district of East Kazakhstan region.The Saint Konir Cave has been considered a sacred place since ancient times. The narrow mouth of the cave is 80-100 meters above the bank of the Chagan River. Basically, there is a narrow cavity on the right side of the cave, which leads to a large room. To the north, the cave roof has 2 domes and continues to the lake. There is a room on the way to the lake from the main room. The air temperature in the cave does not exceed 10 degrees.At the bottom of the Saint Konir`s cave there is a weeping spring and a pond. People have it for healing. A person who falls into a cave and prays will be cured, and those who despair of having children will have a child if they pray to the mysterious forces in the dark places of the “Saint Konir” cave. The cave was considered sacred and became a place of worship for many people. According to locals, their ancestors came here during the war to heal their wounds.The following information about the Saint Konir was provided in the newspaper Vitebskie Gubernenskie Vedomosti №63 in 1892: “The Saint Konir is a cave of the Kazakh saints near Semipalatinsk, where many people come to worship the statue of a woman. It is surrounded by small stone objects, beads and bronze sculptures. Sacrifices will be made near the saint, and in case of an epidemic, sick animals will be brought here”.

semei-poligony-qurbandaryna-arnalgan-oli.fact: It is located on the island of Tuyemoynak in Semey, East Kazakhstan region.Semipalatinsk nuclear test site is one of…
semei-poligony-qurbandaryna-arnalgan-oli.lead: It is located on the island of Tuyemoynak in Semey, East Kazakhstan region.Semipalatinsk nuclear test site is one of the most tragic places in the world. The total capacity of nuclear charges tested in the air and on the ground at the Semipalatinsk test site was 2.5 thousand times greater than the capacity of the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima in 1945.
semei-poligony-qurbandaryna-arnalgan-oli.bodyHtml:
It is located on the island of Tuyemoynak in Semey, East Kazakhstan region.Semipalatinsk nuclear test site is one of the most tragic places in the world. The total capacity of nuclear charges tested in the air and on the ground at the Semipalatinsk test site was 2.5 thousand times greater than the capacity of the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima in 1945. As a result of 456 surface and underground nuclear tests in the area of the Semipalatinsk nuclear test site, a large amount of radioactive materials was released into the atmosphere, hydrosphere and lithosphere. Not only the Semipalatinsk nuclear test site, but also large areas adjacent to it were exposed to radioactive contamination. As a result, many living organisms and populations in the area were affected. About 500 thousand people living in the radiation zone near Semipalatinsk suffered from this test.The monument “Stronger than Death” is important for the Kazakh people, because it depicts the victims of nuclear tests in 1949-1963. On August 28, 1991, the President of Kazakhstan Nursultan Nazarbayev Nazarbayev issued a decree to close the Semipalatinsk landfill. This was an important event in the history of our country. The memorial to the landfill symbolizes peace, the absence of war, prosperity and unity, the terrible tragedy of the past.

alzhir-memorialdy-kesheni.name: Museum-memorial complex of victims of political repression and totalitarianism "ALZHIR"
alzhir-memorialdy-kesheni.fact: The museum-memorial complex of victims of political repression and totalitarianism “ALZHIR” is a unique historical…
alzhir-memorialdy-kesheni.lead: The museum-memorial complex of victims of political repression and totalitarianism “ALZHIR” is a unique historical monument of the past years, opened by the initiative of the First President of the Republic of Kazakhstan N.A.
alzhir-memorialdy-kesheni.bodyHtml:
The museum-memorial complex of victims of political repression and totalitarianism “ALZHIR” is a unique historical monument of the past years, opened by the initiative of the First President of the Republic of Kazakhstan N.A. Nazarbayevon May 31, 2007 in the village of Akmol, Tselinograd district, Akmola region, on the territory of the former Akmola camp of wives of traitors to the Motherland.

The opening of the museum was timed to the 10th anniversary of the adoption in 1997 of the “Decree on the Establishment of the Day of Remembrance for the Victims of Political Repression - May 31”, the 70th anniversary of the beginning of mass political repression that claimed millions of lives.

The museum-memorial complex "ALZHIR" is the only one not only in the post-Soviet space, but throughout the world, a unique museum dedicated to the memory of women prisoners of 62 nationalities, victims of the totalitarian system of the last century.

Over 18 thousand women have passed the stage through the camps of the Gulag, they are constantly moved from one camp to another. About 8,000 women served time in “ALZHIR” from the beginning to the end. Most of them are Russian women - 4,390 people (50%), then Jewish - 855 people (20%), Ukrainian women - 740 people (15%) and Kazakh women - 87 people (2%). Also in the camp served time the Germans, French, Swedish, Japanese, Norwegian, Austrian, Polish, Georgian, Armenian, Azeri, Lithuanian, latviski, etc. died). About 600 women died in the camp (the exact figure is being specified).

These were mainly wives of well-known state, political and public figures whose names were widely known throughout the former Soviet Union: AzizaRyskulova and her mother ArifaYesengulova, DameshZhurgeneva, RabigaAsfendiyarova, singer Lydia Ruslanova, writer Galina Serebryakova, women from the family of the executed Marshal Tukhachevsky,the wife of the writer Boris Pilnyak Kira Andronnikoshvili, Yuri Trifonov, Yevgeny Lurie, the mothers of BulatOkudzhava and Maya Plisetskaya.

The main activities of the Museum and Memorial Complex "ALZHIR" are stock, research and exhibition and exhibition work.

The museum-memorial complex includes a museum, a monument "Tribulation Arch", a memorial "The Wall of Memory" with the names of 7620 dead prisoners of the camp, two sculptural compositions "Despair and Impotence", "Struggle and Hope", "Tears" stele, “Stalin's wagon”, the park "Alash" two alleys, and the museum itself.

The exposition of the Museum is presented on two floors. The exhibition hall "Alash" presents the history of Kazakhstan since the entry of Kazakhstan into the tsarist Empire, as the Soviet period, mass repression in 1937. The history is presented in the form of archival documents, photos and videos, interrogation Protocol, orders for executions, personal files of the repressed.


The exhibition and exhibition hall on the first floor of the “Prisoner of “ALZHIR”is devoted to the history of Akmola camp of the wives of traitors to the Motherland, innocent women who did not commit any crime who had to serve a sentence. The exhibition presents family photos, personal items, work done by the hands of prisoners in the camp.

One of the most unique exhibits of the Museum "ALZHIR" are miniature sculptures of bread crumb, made in the camp by the prisoners of "ALZHIR", depicting mothers with children, reflecting the fact that most worried about women who were in captivity, the pain of losing children; children's letters to their mothers in the “ALZHIR”, one of which is sister of Ira and Zoe Novikov asked the people's Commissar Beria to return to their mother; the blanket of Yanina Germanovich in the camp swaddled his four-month-old daughter Maya, and the belt embroidered by her in the camp. Before the transfer of the blanket to the Museum it was kept as the most expensive family heirloom.

The first monument to the victims of political repression "Kak aiyrylgan zhuldyz- Broken Star” was installed in the village of Malinovka (now Akmol) in 1989, when the topic of repression was not openly discussed in society. At the same time, on the outskirts of the village, places of mass graves of ALZHIR prisoners and their children were discovered. Now there are memorial signs.

In memory of those who suffered in the years of repression, was the hell of the camps on the territory of the Museum there is a stele "Tears", which depicts a map of the Gulag, title 11 of the camps, the tears of the women and children behind barbed wire.

Every year on May 31, Kazakhstan celebrates the day of memory of victims of political repression and hunger. On this day, the Ceremony of laying flowers at the Memorial to the victims of political repression and totalitarianism, as well as a rally in memory of the repressed is held on the territory of the Museum.

abylai-han-alany.fact: Abylai Khan Square is a unique natural monument located at the foot of Kokshetau mountain in Burabay district, Akmola…
abylai-han-alany.lead: Abylai Khan Square is a unique natural monument located at the foot of Kokshetau mountain in Burabay district, Akmola region. In 1991, a pillar was erected on Abylai Khan Square and the exposition complex “Abylai Khan” was opened by President Nursultan Nazarbayev.
abylai-han-alany.bodyHtml:
Abylai Khan Square is a unique natural monument located at the foot of Kokshetau mountain in Burabay district, Akmola region. In 1991, a pillar was erected on Abylai Khan Square and the exposition complex “Abylai Khan” was opened by President Nursultan Nazarbayev. The area of ​​the museum opened on Ablai Khan Square is 288 square meters.

In the middle of the XVIII century on the square of the present Abylai khan dances of the three zhuzs and nobles held Kurultai, Ablai was elected khan on white felt. Then Ablai stood up and said, “Be on the throne, and I will go to my soldiers. And this picturesque place is just a place for entertainment. “The khan's large square is called” Khan's mahogany”. Today, the small square of Abylai Khan is a popular gathering place for tourists from all over the world. In the middle of this square there is a 37-meter-high pole. It was built of white marble by architects led by Karaganda artist Erlan Aituarov. The octagonal monument is inside the circle.

The exposition complex includes three main objects: Abylai Khan's castle, history hall and koumiss. One of the most famous objects of the complex is Abylai Khan. It is a naturally occurring white granite stone. Abylai Khan Square is a natural monument characterized by a unique microclimate.

qosbatyr-qumai-memorialdy-kesheni.fact: It is located in the natural national park “Buirattau” Ereymentau district of Akmola region.

qosbatyr-qumai-memorialdy-kesheni.bodyHtml:
It is located in the natural national park “Buirattau” Ereymentau district of Akmola region. Chronological period: VII-VIII centuries.

Archaeological and ethnographic complex “Kosbatyr” is a complex of spiritual life of the Turkic era, located on the banks of the river Kumai (synonymous with the concept of Umai). The name “Kosbatyr” can be seen in a double balbal with a weapon in his left hand and a bowl in his right hand. It was believed in the unity of God and the earth and water, and it was recognized as a god who represented them on earth.

The ceremonial enclosure next to the statue is as sacred as a sacred roof and a hearth. It is surrounded by special heroes. Images were created depicting the sky (the beginning of the sun-men) and the Earth (the beginning of the moon-women). He was considered the god of earth and water and prayed in his name.

The Turks considered the world as infinite, time as eternal, and there was no image of a god in their art. The worshipers of the great ancestors, who were blessed by heaven, were provided with life on earth by Mother Umai, the giver of life and its preserver. The lord of the heavens was a member of the Ashina dynasty. The place where he lived was called a holy place. They allow us to determine the area of ​​development of the Turkic tribes in the Kazakh land and the spiritual confidence in the formation of the state of the Turks, who are the autochthonous inhabitants of this area.

zhambyl-zhabaev-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Zhambyl Zhabayev
zhambyl-zhabaev-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Zhambyl Zhabayev was built in 1946 in the village of Zhambyl, Zhambyl district, Almaty region.
zhambyl-zhabaev-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Zhambyl Zhabayev was built in 1946 in the village of Zhambyl, Zhambyl district, Almaty region. In 1970 and 1996, it was renovated and covered with white marble. The mausoleum is a single-chamber, octagonal portal building.
zhambyl-zhabaev-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Zhambyl Zhabayev was built in 1946 in the village of Zhambyl, Zhambyl district, Almaty region. In 1970 and 1996, it was renovated and covered with white marble. The mausoleum is a single-chamber, octagonal portal building. It is 10 m high, made of baked brick, with a hexagonal drum-shaped cone-shaped dome. Right next to the mausoleum, on the left threshold, there is a statue of the poet - a red tiger.

Zhambyl Zhabayev (1846-1945) - poet, zhyrau, poet. His main work before the October Revolution was aitys. In his poems, the poet sang about heroes and their heroic deeds. His poem “The Leningrad Song”, written for the heroes who defended the besieged city of Leningrad during the war, is the best work of multinational Soviet literature. Zhambyl Zhyrau knew by heart stories, epics, thermae, heroic songs. Zhambyl followed the example of the poet and received his blessing, saying: He defeated Kulmanbet, who won nine poets at the same time, thanks to his quick wit and rational speech. Zhambyl "Korugly", etc. memorized ancient epic poems. During Zhambyl's lifetime, the city of Aulieata was named after him. At that moment, the poet sang: “I'll turn around in your name, Aulieata, don't be upset that your name has been changed”.

zharkent-meshiti-saulet-korkemoner-keshe.lead: The complex, located in the center of Zharkent, Almaty region, is an architectural monument with a boat roof, tower, portal, built in the late XIX century, decorated with various patterns. The mosque complex has a portal (main gate), a domed house for mosque employees and a madrasah.
zharkent-meshiti-saulet-korkemoner-keshe.bodyHtml:
The complex, located in the center of Zharkent, Almaty region, is an architectural monument with a boat roof, tower, portal, built in the late XIX century, decorated with various patterns.

The mosque complex has a portal (main gate), a domed house for mosque employees and a madrasah. The general contractor of the construction was the second clay merchant Uali Ahun Yuldashov, and the chief architect was the Chinese master Hong Pik (Hong Fi), whom the locals called Mukan. The complex was built at the expense of local rich people. Representatives of different nationalities took part in the construction of the mosque. It was built without any nails. On the walls and sides of the roof of the magnificent painted building there are more than 1,500 different paintings, ancient inscriptions in Arabic and Persian. On the wall in front of the pulpit, where the head of the main mosque sits, there is an olive-shaped "tree of life" based on the legends of the Indian people.

tekturmas-kesheni.name: Tekturmas Complex
tekturmas-kesheni.fact: Zhambyl region is located in the south-eastern part of Taraz on a high hill on the banks of the Talas River.
tekturmas-kesheni.lead: Zhambyl region is located in the south-eastern part of Taraz on a high hill on the banks of the Talas River. The mausoleum was built for the tomb of the holy Sultan Mahmud (XIV century) and is believed to be the burial place of the khan.
tekturmas-kesheni.bodyHtml:
Zhambyl region is located in the south-eastern part of Taraz on a high hill on the banks of the Talas River. The mausoleum was built for the tomb of the holy Sultan Mahmud (XIV century) and is believed to be the burial place of the khan.Tekturmas (nickname) is a religious healer, a saint. Due to a widespread legend, at the age of seven he became a Sufi, a great cleric, and his grandfather taught him underground. He memorizes the Quran. As you grow up, you will see a special nature in the soul, a special ability, a great being. He first heals. The sick people who came to him could find a cure for their illnesses and be healed. Infectious lung disease (worm), the spread of leprosy, which was widespread and difficult to cure, was prevented and cured by him. In this way, the benevolent people, who traveled the country in vain, did not call him by his name, but called him “Tekturmas Auliy”. Tekturmas auliye never tired of saying to all the sick people, who came to the saint: “God, who gives pain, also gives medicine, and I am the only cause”.

qarahan-kesenesi.name: Karakhan Mausoleum
qarahan-kesenesi.fact: Zhambyl region is located in the central part of Taraz.
qarahan-kesenesi.lead: Zhambyl region is located in the central part of Taraz. The mausoleum is built on the tomb of Shah Mahmud Karakhan, one of the prominent figures of the Karakhanid dynasty.
qarahan-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
Zhambyl region is located in the central part of Taraz. The mausoleum is built on the tomb of Shah Mahmud Karakhan, one of the prominent figures of the Karakhanid dynasty. Karakhan (XII century) was known in the country as an authoritative, saintly man. His tomb was called ”Auliye Ata Dome” in the country. Satuk considers Boghra Khan (915-955) as the founder of the Karakhan dynasty. Converting to Islam and using the support of the Samanids, Satuk Boghra Khan rebelled against Ogulshak and defeated him, thus conquering Taraz and Kashgar. In 942, he overthrew the ruler of Balasagun and proclaimed himself supreme kagan. The history of the Karakhanid state dates back to this time.The tribes that formed the basis of the Karakhan Khaganate (840-1212), founded by the Blue Turks, are called Kangly, Karluk, Shikil, Yagma, and Turkesh. The Karakhanid dynasty came from the Karluks. The Karluks included everyone except Kipchak. The Karluks brought Islam to the Sahara. During the reign of the Karakhanids, Sufism was especially developed in the Kazakh Sahara, and the number of Sufi healers who followed the path of piety and renounced the world increased. The place of worship was a mountain.

aisha-bibi-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Aisha Bibi
aisha-bibi-kesenesi.fact: It is located in Aisha Bibi aul of Zhambyl district of Zhambyl region.
aisha-bibi-kesenesi.lead: It is located in Aisha Bibi aul of Zhambyl district of Zhambyl region. The mausoleum of Aisha Bibi (XI-XII centuries) is one of the most important monuments of the Karakhanid state.
aisha-bibi-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
It is located in Aisha Bibi aul of Zhambyl district of Zhambyl region. The mausoleum of Aisha Bibi (XI-XII centuries) is one of the most important monuments of the Karakhanid state. The mausoleum has no analogues in the architectural and construction culture of Kazakhstan and Central Asia.According to the legend, Aisha Bibi was the daughter of the famous scientist of the XI century, poet Khakim Suleimen Bakyrgani. After his death, Aisha was brought up by Sheikh Aikozhy. Aisha Bibi met a young hero Karakhan, they fell in love with each other and agreed to join. Karakhan, who is defending his country, will not be able to visit Aisha at the agreed time. Exhausted, Aisha decided to go to Taraz, the home of Karakhan, and set off with her babysitter, Babaja Khatun. With a half-day trip to Taraz, he stopped to rest on the river bank, bit his eye and fell asleep. Aisha immediately fell in love with Karakhan. When Karakhan brought the healers, the girl was tired. At that moment, Karakhan told the mullah Aisha, who was about to get married, "Aisha, you are now a grandmother!" He shouted three times. Karakhan, who lost his lover and was bleeding from grief, buried the body of his beloved wife and placed a beautiful dome on her head. The mausoleum of Aisha Bibi is the first architectural building dedicated to women in Central Asia. Later, this process was not uncommon in the Sahara.

babadzha-hatun-kesenesi.name: The Mausoleum of Babadja Khatun
babadzha-hatun-kesenesi.fact: The center of Zhambyl region is located near the mausoleum of Aisha Bibi, 18 km from Taraz.
babadzha-hatun-kesenesi.lead: The center of Zhambyl region is located near the mausoleum of Aisha Bibi, 18 km from Taraz. The legend of the construction of the mausoleum of Babaja Khatun (X-XI centuries) is directly related to the legend of the construction of the mausoleum of Aisha Bibi.
babadzha-hatun-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The center of Zhambyl region is located near the mausoleum of Aisha Bibi, 18 km from Taraz. The legend of the construction of the mausoleum of Babaja Khatun (X-XI centuries) is directly related to the legend of the construction of the mausoleum of Aisha Bibi. According to the legend, the mausoleum was built on the grave of Babaja Khatun, the nanny of Aisha, who after her death served as a lifelong torchbearer of the young tomb.

The mausoleum has a square shape, the walls are 1.23 meters thick. Made of open fired brick. The architectural composition of the Babaja-Khatun mausoleum is simple and has few decorations. On three facades of the building (except for the western facade) there are cavities and talismans. The surface of the facade walls is decorated with false arches and cavities. There are brick circles on the windows. The 16-sided conical roof of the mausoleum, located on a prismatic drum, which gives art and elegance, is one of the most unique domes of Kazakhstan.

aqyrtas-qalashygy.name: Akyrtas Town
aqyrtas-qalashygy.fact: Turar Ruskulov district of Zhambyl region is located 6 km south of Akchulak railway station, 45 km from Taraz.
aqyrtas-qalashygy.lead: Turar Ruskulov district of Zhambyl region is located 6 km south of Akchulak railway station, 45 km from Taraz. Chronological period VIII-IX centuries. Akyrtas is an incomplete, medieval palace complex. The palace complex consists of about 70 rooms and a gallery with 15 columns.
aqyrtas-qalashygy.bodyHtml:
Turar Ruskulov district of Zhambyl region is located 6 km south of Akchulak railway station, 45 km from Taraz. Chronological period VIII-IX centuries.

Akyrtas is an incomplete, medieval palace complex. The palace complex consists of about 70 rooms and a gallery with 15 columns. The complex is built of large paving stones. As a result of archeological and scientific research, several objects were found near Akyrtas: a caravanserai complex and a monumental building.

The construction of Akyrtas was completed in 1867. Orientalist P.I. Lerch studied the unfinished Buddhist temple, and in 1893 the academician V.V. Barthold suggested that it was a Nestorian temple. V.A. Callaur takes Akyrtas to Kasribas. A.A. Divayev, publishing the legend of the giant Aja, known as Alansor-Alip, points out that it has a historical basis, noting that it is home to medieval settlements, including Akyrtas.

The Akyrtas complex is considered to be a complex and mysterious object at the level of the Egyptian wonders, the Acropolis of Athens, the Roman Colosseum, the Mayan palaces in Peru and a huge building on a par with ancient legends. The Akyrtas complex, located along the Great Silk Road, was included in the World Heritage List on June 25, 2014 during the 38th session of UNESCO in Doha, Qatar.

taraz-qalashygy.name: Taraz Town
taraz-qalashygy.fact: The center of Zhambyl region is located on the territory of the central market of Taraz. Chronological date:.B.C.
taraz-qalashygy.lead: The center of Zhambyl region is located on the territory of the central market of Taraz. Chronological date:.B.C. I century- XIX century.It is one of the oldest cities along the Talas River.
taraz-qalashygy.bodyHtml:
The center of Zhambyl region is located on the territory of the central market of Taraz. Chronological date:.B.C. I century- XIX century.It is one of the oldest cities along the Talas River. The medieval city of Taraz was the largest political, cultural, trade and administrative center in the history of Kazakhstan. In its 2100-year history, the city has changed its name several times: Daloos, Dalose, Taraz, Yangi-Taraz, Aulie Ata, Mirzoyan, Zhambyl, Taraz.The city of Taraz is founded in 568 in Byzantine records. Then the Chinese monk Xuan Jiang, who came to the city in 630, described that "merchants from different countries live in Taraz." And in the IX century. Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi, a medieval mathematician and geographer who lived in the first half of the twentieth century, wrote in Kitab Surat al-Ard: "Taraz is a city of merchants." Abu Qasim ibn Haukal, an Arab traveler, wrote, "Taraz is a place where Muslim Turks trade, and no Muslim will go further, because whoever crosses its borders will find a tent (settlement) of Karluks." Another prominent Arab geographer, Muhammad ibn Ahmed al-Maqdisi, described Taraz as "a large fortified city with many gardens, densely populated, with a pit, four gates, and a rabad." Mahmud Kashgari in his work "Diwani lugat-at-turk" wrote: "Talas is a city known as Taraz. They are two: one of them is the Great Talas, which is large, and the other is on the Islamic border - Kumi Talas. Taraz is home to several khaganates established in the region in the early Middle Ages: Western Turkic, Karakhan, etc. It is the political capital of the Soviet Union, a city of civilization and culture along the Great Silk Road, a center of trade and crafts, science and education.

ekidin-guryptyq-eskertkishi.fact: Arkalyk town of Kostanay region is located northeast of the aul of Ekidyn, on both sides of the river Karatorgai.

ekidin-guryptyq-eskertkishi.bodyHtml:
Arkalyk town of Kostanay region is located northeast of the aul of Ekidyn, on both sides of the river Karatorgai. Chronological period: about VIII-III centuries BCE.The monument consists of two objects. Ekidyn I is located on the left bank of the river Karatorgai, Ekidyn II is higher, well visible from a distance. The distance between the two is 4 km.According to legend, in the XVII-XVIII centuries there were battles and bloodshed on the site of these objects. It was here that the military leaders of the two warring tribes set up their hordes. Both are built of stone and look like yurts. The monument was studied in 1959 by a scientific expedition led by A. Margulan. According to A.Margulan, this monument reflects the development of the first art of house building in Kazakh culture.

isatai-taimanuly-kesenesi.name: The Mausoleum of Isatai Taimanuly
isatai-taimanuly-kesenesi.fact: The mausoleum of Isatai Batyr is located in Sheitsai, Kobda district, Aktobe region.
isatai-taimanuly-kesenesi.lead: The mausoleum of Isatai Batyr is located in Sheitsai, Kobda district, Aktobe region. Isatai Taimanuly (1804-1846) - 1836-38.
isatai-taimanuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
The mausoleum of Isatai Batyr is located in Sheitsai, Kobda district, Aktobe region. Isatai Taimanuly (1804-1846) - 1836-38. Political leader of the uprising in Western Kazakhstan, commander, people's hero. “During the reign of Zhangir, Bokei's people reduced migration and became sedentary. Each tribe had a certain wintering and summer pasture. During the summer and winter, the country could not exceed the limits of 1806. During the unfavorable summers or severe winters, there were strong conflicts between the Kazakhs and the neighboring countries. The famine has increased. The country became poor. Zhangir did not defend the Kazakhs, he did not have enough power to defend them. Kazakhs-Russians along the Edil-Zhaik and the rich along the Tengiz invaded the Kazakh lands”, - wrote Khalel Dosmukhameduly in the chapter “A Brief Information on the Movement of Isatai Taimanuly” in his book “Alaman”. “The time of Isatai was the time when the tsarist government was close to mastering the Kazakh”. It was stated that the uprising was suppressed, but the independent spirit did not die.

qobylandy-batyr-memorialdyq-kesheni.name: Kobylandy Batyr Memorial Complex
qobylandy-batyr-memorialdyq-kesheni.fact: The memorial complex is located in Zhirenkopa village of Kobda district of Aktobe region.
qobylandy-batyr-memorialdyq-kesheni.lead: The memorial complex is located in Zhirenkopa village of Kobda district of Aktobe region. The mausoleum is dedicated to the black Kipchak Kobylandy batyr Toktarbayuly (XV).
qobylandy-batyr-memorialdyq-kesheni.bodyHtml:
The memorial complex is located in Zhirenkopa village of Kobda district of Aktobe region. The mausoleum is dedicated to the black Kipchak Kobylandy batyr Toktarbayuly (XV). The mausoleum is located at the burial place of the hero. One of the sources about Kobylandy batyr is one of the epic heroic songs of the Kazakh people - the song “Kobylandy batyr”. According to the events of this song, Kobyland's heroic journey begins with the struggle against the enemy of the Kazakhs at that time - the Kyzylbas (Persians) and their invading khan Kazan. Judging by the names of the batyrs they fought against, it is clear that they are the descendants of the famous Yedige batyr. Kobylandy batyr's friendship with Orak batyr and his enmity with Alshagyr - a historical period in which the Kazakh Khanate supported one of the internally divided Nogai hordes and fought with the other.

Orazak Ismagulov, the head of the Central State Laboratory of Anthropology of the Republic of Kazakhstan, identified and proved that the remains in the tomb belonged to Kobylandy batyr.

abat-baitaq-kesenesi.name: The Mausoleum of Abat-Baitak
abat-baitaq-kesenesi.fact: It is located 12 km south-west of Taldysai village of Kobda district of Aktobe region.
abat-baitaq-kesenesi.lead: It is located 12 km south-west of Taldysai village of Kobda district of Aktobe region. Abat-Baitak mausoleum of the XIV-XV centuries. The only monument of the Nogai state, created instead of the Golden Horde empire.
abat-baitaq-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
It is located 12 km south-west of Taldysai village of Kobda district of Aktobe region. Abat-Baitak mausoleum of the XIV-XV centuries. The only monument of the Nogai state, created instead of the Golden Horde empire.

The monument is a portal-dome mausoleum. The body is rectangular, with an 11-sided pedestal with a pig dome. External dimensions - 9.52 x 9.8 m. The initial height of the mausoleum is 16 m. It is made of untreated brick, the inside is plastered with clay, and the outside is covered with burnt brick.

This monument was first mentioned in the P.I. Rychkov's work “Topography of Orenburg”. Only at the end of the XIX century this monument was described as a legend by Y.Y. Polferov. Abat Batyr is an epic song included in the collection “Forty Heroes of Crimea”. The song, which is preserved in the form of a folk tale, tells about the war of Aban Batyr, the son of Asan grief, for the freedom and independence of the country, the murder of his opponent Kaibarbatyr in battle.

mahambet-otemisuly-kesenesi.name: Mausoleum of Makhambet Utemisuli
mahambet-otemisuly-kesenesi.fact: It is located 40 km south-east of Inderbor aul of Inder district of Atyrau region.
mahambet-otemisuly-kesenesi.lead: It is located 40 km south-east of Inderbor aul of Inder district of Atyrau region. The mausoleum of Makhambet Utemisuli was built in 1995 over the tomb of the poet.
mahambet-otemisuly-kesenesi.bodyHtml:
It is located 40 km south-east of Inderbor aul of Inder district of Atyrau region. The mausoleum of Makhambet Utemisuli was built in 1995 over the tomb of the poet. Makhambet Utemisuli (1804-1846) - the great Kazakh free-thinking poet of the XIX century, kuishi composer, one of the organizers of the anti-colonial uprising led by Isatai Taimanov (1836-1838), an ardent poet of this uprising. Makhambet Utemisuli was a religious man who was fluent in several languages and had a deep understanding of Islam. An important place in the work of the poet has always been the uprising of 1836-1837, in his poems it is felt the intensity of the struggle, resistance to injustice, high spirits, heroism and love for the people, in his poems he expressed the dreams and needs of ordinary people of the Kazakh steppe.

aqmeshit-qorymy.name: Akmeshit Necropolis
aqmeshit-qorymy.fact: It is located 28 km northeast of Akkiiztoy aul, Zhylyoi district, Atyrau region.
aqmeshit-qorymy.lead: It is located 28 km northeast of Akkiiztoy aul, Zhylyoi district, Atyrau region. The main object of the complex is an underground mosque built by Beket Ata. The construction of the mosque, which lasted for three years (1771-1773), was led by a young man from the aul Sokyrsha.
aqmeshit-qorymy.bodyHtml:
It is located 28 km northeast of Akkiiztoy aul, Zhylyoi district, Atyrau region. The main object of the complex is an underground mosque built by Beket Ata. The construction of the mosque, which lasted for three years (1771-1773), was led by a young man from the aul Sokyrsha. It has been written about in the scientific and historical literature since the XIX century. According to the Russian researcher E. Eversman, who visited Mangistau and Zhem in 1820-1821, “Mosques carved from the mountains on the plateau are decorated with Persian, Arabic and Tatar inscriptions. Such a monument-necropolis was built by Beket in four places. The third of them is on the river Zhem ... ”According to sources, Beket Ata visited Akmeshit, which he built as a young man. 1851-1852 Russian traveler, lieutenant Alekseev also took into account Akmeshit when conducting a topographic survey of the Ustyurt. In his book "Geographical characteristics of the Northern Ustyurt", published in 1853, he wrote: In this mosque Beket taught boys and wrote letters. In addition to the mosque, the Akmeshit complex includes a reserve consisting of 32 tombstones, 2 sheep, 2 domed mausoleums and one saganatam. 13 tombstones will have architectural, historical and ethnographic significance.

saraishyq-qalashygy.name: Saraishyk Ancient Settlement
saraishyq-qalashygy.fact: The center of the West Kazakhstan region is located 50 km from Atyrau.
saraishyq-qalashygy.lead: The center of the West Kazakhstan region is located 50 km from Atyrau. Chronological period: XIII-XVI centuries.Saraishyk is one of the most important cities along the Great Silk Road, connecting the West and the East, a medieval city that later became the Khan's Horde.
saraishyq-qalashygy.bodyHtml:
The center of the West Kazakhstan region is located 50 km from Atyrau. Chronological period: XIII-XVI centuries.Saraishyk is one of the most important cities along the Great Silk Road, connecting the West and the East, a medieval city that later became the Khan's Horde. The first information about the Saraishyk was found in medieval inscriptions.Saraishyk is a city where the disintegrating tribes and uluses of the Golden Horde empire and the Nogai tribes came together. It is the largest trade center of the Golden Horde, the center of science and culture, the first religious center of Islam in the western region. Architectural palaces, caravanserais, baths, mosques, madrassas and other buildings were built in the Saraishyk. The influence of the East was especially noticeable in the appearance of the city. The city of Saraishyk grew rapidly due to caravan trade, military booty, taxes paid by the local population and a large amount of cheap labor.In the XIV century, Saraishyk was destroyed by the Timur the Lame, but it was rebuilt in the 30s and 40s of the XV century and in the late XIV and XIVI centuries. It became the capital of the Kazakh Khanate.Kasym Khan and other khans, influential people, seids, sheikhs, mullahs, pilgrims, hafizs, Sufis and Dauris, who are considered to be the descendants of the Prophet Muhammad, lived and were buried here. The shed pantheon was a sacred place for the burial of rulers and celebrities. In 1580 (according to some sources in 1581), the city was completely destroyed and reduced to ashes by the invasion of the Don and Volga Cossacks.
